notes.title: V1.1.14 Update Log
notes.content: [p]Dear Desert Travelers,[/p][p]In this update, we’re introducing a new feature: randomly generated NPCs, along with new talents related to captives.[/p][p][/p][p]Once the “Execution” feature is enabled and the game progresses, players who prefer a swift and decisive approach may find that some factions don’t even have anybody left. To prevent this situation, we’ve designed a new automatic NPC generation system. The generated NPCs will come with different skillsets and outfits based on the starting region of their faction.[/p][p]As the months tick by, the world will once again bustle with life no matter how many NPCs you execute. However, newly generated NPCs are based on models and might only have access to a few set talents and skill pages, meaning that they'll be inferior to the original NPCs.[/p][p][/p][h2]V1.1.14 Update Log[/h2][list][*][p]Added new talents related to Captives. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a character creation system that populates different regions and factions with randomly generated NPCs. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a character avatar coloring system, allowing color customization for certain components: [/p][list][*][p]Male avatars: two new dyeable hair styles and two dyeable clothing items. [/p][/*][*][p]Female avatars: one new dyeable hair style and two dyeable clothing items.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.1.13 Update Log: Improved Combat Pathing & Mod Compatibility Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]0328Update Log[/h2]
1. Improved combat pathfinding: Units now prioritize moving in squads, reducing CPU load for path calculations and resolving terrain issues that previously caused units to get stuck.
2. Fixed script compatibility issues with certain older mods, reducing the likelihood of mod failures due to script conflicts.
3. Optimized battlefield wall models in the Siege and Conquest DLC: Walls now become semi-transparent when players approach to reduce visual obstruction.
4. Fixed recruitment bug in the Child Rearing DLC: In some cases, grown-up offspring and their mothers could not be properly recruited.
5. Added a visibility condition column for scenario-based mods files, allowing control over whether a scenario appears as available.
6. Fixed translation errors in the English and Korean version of The Ember Saga DLC related to inheritance mechanics.

notes.title: v1.1.10 Update Log
notes.content:
Travelers of the desert,

We've just released a new update, introducing enhancements to the Captives system along with numerous bug fixes.
Oh, and we're running the Winter Promotion on Sands of Salzaar—now available at its lowest price ever for the next two weeks!

[h2]V1.1.10 Update Log[/h2]
[h3]New Feature of Captive system[/h3]
[list]
[*] Accommodation for Captives: You can now configure food rations and healing for both heroes and soldiers. Proper rations help captives replenish health, increasing your success rate when recruiting them. However, a lack of food—while boosting recruitment success—can harm their health.
[*] Chiefs from various tribes may now approach you to request the release of their captives.
[*] If a dungeon containing captives is breached, the captives will either be released or captured by enemy forces.
[*] Captives in your squad now have a chance to escape if you exceed the limit.
[*] Adjusted the probability rates for taking captives.
[*] Adjusted the probability rates for capturing heroes.
[*] Adjusted resource rewards for releasing captives.
[/list]

[h3]Optimization and Adjustment[/h3]
Added Financial Statistics: A new UI feature (top-right corner) displays daily and weekly income/expenditure details. For tribal chiefs, the treasury's funds will also be visible.    
Treasury Management Menu: A portion of your faction's revenue will now be automatically added to your treasury. You can customize this ratio to suit your strategy.
Adjustment: There is now a maximum limit for captives. Exceeding this limit gives the captives a chance to escape.
Adjustment: Products bought at varying prices will now stack automatically. The unit price will recalculate based on the total cost.

[h3]Mods:[/h3]
Translation Support: Added support for creating translation-type mods for both the game and open-source mods.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
Fixed a bug with EXP acquisition.
Fixed a bug where certain story NPCs dropped gear after battle.
Fixed a bug where gift-giving would sometimes malfunction.


[h2]DLC Update Logs[/h2]
[h3]Child Rearing DLC - Update Log:[/h3]
1. Fixed a bug where duplicate quests could occasionally appear for the same heir.
2. Merged interaction options with your heir/better half under [About our relationship].
3. Successfully wooed characters (without DLC-specific methods) will now unlock DLC interactions through [About our relationship] and grant you the rings.
4. The Heir's [Shaman] skill page is now an Heir-exclusive one.
5. Children born of a female protagonist will now inherit your skills.
6. Fixed a bug where some quests incorrectly applied attribute gains to the female protagonist instead of the heir.

[h3]The Eclipse Hive DLC - Update Log[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the localization regarding to the Mastigure Adventurers quest.
[*] Fixed a bug where completing the [Lava Void] instance didn't reward Eclipse Clues.
[*] Fixed a bug where repeatedly loading a save file impacted Eclipse Clue drop rates.
[*] Increased Eclipse Clue drop rates.
[*] Fixed a bug where the [Mutant Grunt] (a Land of the Eclipse boss) could unexpectedly die when using [Surging Blood].
[*] Allies now follow the protagonist after defeating a Land of the Eclipse boss to prevent obscuring loot.
[*] Updated some Land of the Eclipse weapon models.
[*] Added Eclipse-specific crafting materials, usable for gear crafting at the Adventurer of the Mastigure Council.
[*] [Sanskrit Shura Necklace]: Supplemented a missing description.
[*] [Bloodsteel Armor/True Bloodsteel Armor]: Reduced the active skill's Reflect damage to (Physical Attack x 1 + Strength x 2), down from (Physical Attack x 2.5 + Strength x 5).
[*] [Tricolor Gem Armor/Spring's Boon]: Fixed 'when hit' effects triggering other passives.
[*] [Amber Snake Eye/Emerald Snake Eye]: Fixed missing cooldowns for their skills.
[*] [Light Phantom Gauze/Crimson Phantom Gauze]: Fixed issues with evade chances.
[*] [Fists of the Sands/Dunerift Fists]: Fixed issue with negative status effect and stun chances.
[*] [Sanskrit Vicissitude Wizal]: Fixed the 95% Arcane/Physical attack reduction not taking effect after Sanskrit: Reserve shield expired.
[/list]

[h3]Ember Workshop DLC - Update Log[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved mod compatibility.
[*] Fixed a bug where some dialogue text didn't display correctly.
[*] Enhanced Magic Dust grinding—you can now select multiple items at once.
[*] Fixed a bug where search events could be triggered after entering an instance while on the [Pestle] quest.
[*] Ember Ocher will now match the protagonist's level when joining the team during the [Final Battle] quest.
[*] Added resource rewards to the [Transmigration of Ember]'s Heir page to balance its cost-effectiveness.
[*] Improved performance for certain story segments.
[/list]

[h3]Tournament DLC - Update Log:[/h3]
Fix: Fixed a bug where enemy heroes could drop their gear.

If you have encountered any issue, please feel free  to contact us through our official Discord channel https://discord.gg/xdindie!

notes.title: v1.1.05 Update Log: fixed the none-exp bug; Future Plans
notes.content:
Travelers of the desert:

We've just launched an update. With this, we've fixed bugs relayed to us in detailed player reports, improved capture mechanics, and adjusted the prices of captured soldiers.
And of course, we'll be taking the opportunity to share our plans for future updates, too.

[h2]V1.1.05 UPDATE LOG:[/h2]
[h3]●Price Changes[/h3]
The Ransom Broker now considers more team factors when presenting a price for captured units. Instead of basing prices solely upon captured units' recruit costs, the team's total number of Captive Squad units remaining will also be taken into account.
[h3]●Captures[/h3]
	We've improved the capturing logic, increasing the factors that come into play when deciding a capture's chance to succeed. Examples include the target's rank, and the number of captives your team has.

We're further addressing issues in which some players found they weren't gaining any EXP after combat. If you've experienced this, please try and see if it's fixed for you! Debug information can be found at the end of this update summary.
If these issues persist following the update, please share your save files with us. We need save data from those experiencing problems if we're to solve them once and for all!

[h2]Future Plan[/h2]
We've been listening closely to player opinions on the Captives system, right from the start of V1.1. The previous two issues aside, we'll continue to focus on adjusting the Captives system in future updates to ensure it's balanced. We'll be fine-tuning ransom and release logic, capture and recruit probabilities, and much more.
[h3]●Captive Status & Recruiting[/h3]
You can provide captives with rations and medical treatment following future updates. That said, whether you choose to do so remains up to you. Will you focus on recruiting captives to survive, or will you deny them rations and treatment? Not all captives will readily yield to you if you choose the latter, however, as it may only serve to strengthen their resolve.
[h3]●Captive Escape[/h3]
Your team has a limited capacity for its captives. Once over this limit, they can choose to make a break for it.
[h3]●Captive Release[/h3]
Releasing a captive improves your Favor with their faction. The released captive also leaves you Ironstone and Wood resources, with a chance to grant Soldier EXP Stones. Releasing non-soldier captives grants you a piece of their equipped gear, with a chance to grant Talent Shards and Wisdom Crystals.
[h3]●Talents[/h3]
We're adding a Captives Talents branch, [Priorities], that offers two different routes to develop down. Perhaps you'll seek out and slay soldier elites, or maybe you'd prefer to subdue tons of lower-ranking targets instead.

Stay tuned for future updates to hear about all this in greater detail.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
●Fixed a bug where Ember Ocher could grind down jewel dust without spending any jewels.
●Fixed a bug where you couldn't return to garrison at the Tribal Hall.
●Fixed a bug where save files created with a hotkey could crash when reloading the game.
●Partly fixed a bug where no EXP is granted from combat.
●Optimized recruitment success rates when the player is the leader.
●Fixed a bug where the Nameless had no Ransom Broker.
●Fixed a bug where enchanting in the Champion of Chaos DLC smithing skill page would cost no equipment.

If you have encountered any issue, please feel free  to contact us through our official Discord channel https://discord.gg/xdindie!

notes.title: Captives Feature Launching - Biggest Discount Ever is ON
notes.content:
Travelers of the desert:
It's been a while!

We've mentioned in a previous update preview that we would add a new feature: Captives. It's been under development for a while now, and we're happy to announce that it's going live with this patch!

In the current build, once you defeat an enemy army, they will be able to rebuild a large army in just a few days and begin attacking you anew, which has led to overly frequent battles in the late game. Plus, war has been the only means with which to annihilate your foes once and for all. Thus, we've thought of adding the Captives mechanic to enable players to make captives of the enemy's wounded units.

If you want to learn more about the ins and outs of the new feature, or if you have any questions or worries, feel free to check out these two development journals where we go into greater detail and answer a few common questions.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1094520/view/4041486102480343224
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1094520/view/4211502058701959226

What's more, the game is [b]on sale at a price equal to our historical lowest price point for two whole weeks[/b] on all platforms. This new update will hit mobile devices in two days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094520/_/

[h2]Sep 06 Update Log[/h2]
●Addition: Captives Feature
Upon being victorious in combat, you make captives of the enemy's wounded units, with a chance to make NPCs your captives. There is a cap for how many Captive Squads you can have, and upon exceeding this cap, you have a 30% each day to lose 1-5 captives. However, should you fall in battle, the enemy may also lay claim to your heroes and soldiers.

You can check any NPCs and units you've captured by tapping the Captives tab in the Party menu. Here you may choose to either Convert or Release captives. NPCs and soldiers are converted differently, however. Once a few days have passed, you receive Conversions, with which you can convert selected soldiers.

NPCs take a longer time to convert and comprise several phases: during each conversion you converse with them, having a chance to progress onto the next conversion phase (this also triggers a cooldown). Complete several of these phases successfully to convert an NPC.
Please be noted that the function of auto-generating NPCs based on event won't be on live until next patch.

●Addition: Dungeon
We've added the [Dungeon] to the town, where captured heroes will be imprisoned. You can choose to either retrieve captives for a cost or—attempt a jailbreak. However, there might be a price to pay for jailbreaks, successful or not, so proceed with caution!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b1403a220940680542517761c198d5eead702326.png[/img]

●Addition: Ransom Broker
We've added a new merchant character too, the Ransom Broker, who will conduct a new form of business: the trading of captives.

●We've reworked the Settings menu and added more quality options.
●Support for different resolutions has also been added.
●Fix: Fixed a bug where the Yaya DLC character's skills could lead to limitless health or instant death.
●Fix: Fixed an issue where ordering a character in a city owned by another faction would also cause that faction's units to deploy.

If you have encountered any problem, feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you out.

notes.title: Update Log-[RAM Improvements][Progression-Halting Bug Fixed][Captives Progress]
notes.content:
[b]Travelers of the desert:[/b]

Travelers of the desert:
This time around we've continued to remedy lag. We came to realize that some art assets weren't fully integrated which in turn led to them taking up unnecessary RAM. This will be resolved with the ver. 1.0.45 update.

What's more, we're adding further support for the mod editor. For this new expert version, we'll be making available most UI menus so that modders can replace or change these out. We'll also provide a feature where you can upgrade simple mods to expert ones and make it easier to create resource packs.


[b]Fixes[/b]

●Fixed a progression-halting bug with the Spirit Witch's [Catch Burak] story:

This bug has been present in our localized versions and was caused by section breakers. The issue should be resolved in the new version; yet, this isn't the only place in the game where this has been happening. We'll look over our localized versions again and make changes where needed.

●Fixed an issue on mobile devices:
where the game would appear vertically for some players.

●Fixed two issues with the text.

●Fixed an issue with Anniversary mod Zombie x Squirrel, where you didn't gain EXP as intended.

●Fixed a bug where a test segment would appear when opening up the Class Shop in the Eclipse Hive DLC.

All of the above changes will be updated on all platforms.


[h2][b]Captives - New Progress[/b][/h2]

We've been working on the new Captives feature as of late, and we've been keeping an eye on your questions and worries. So, we'd like to share our progress and answer some questions in the process, naturally, feel free to leave even more feedback too!

[h2]Captives Gained From Battles[/h2]

[h3] (not representative of the final version)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6da9acc34ff1e37859defe479890f067ecfdc810.png[/img]

There's a chance to capture NPCs when defeating other tribes in battle, which just so happens to be the main way in which to acquire captives. We'll also consider whether to add more ways in which to acquire captives once the feature's been released, such as attacking traveling NPCs or exchanging captives with other forces. However, be sure to quickly toss any excess captives into the dungeon lest captives might begin escaping should you exceed your captive cap.

Apart from capturing NPCs, we're also planning on perhaps making soldiers capturable. However, that would require adjustments to several UI menus and we'll need time to discuss and think about whether or how we'll make this work.

[h2]What Use Are Captives?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/839ca04c69873d5d7971f55e0d169c7c0a81896b.png[/img]

Following our last update log, many of you have been asking what captives are used for. They're honestly similar to how they are in many other games: they can be sold for gold to slavers, executed (after which that NPC will be permanently gone from your game), or released. Or, you can even draft them into your own team (with some restrictions, of course).

Soldiers of a higher level and NPCs of a higher status are naturally worth more. You'll also be able to hand over nobility captives when interacting with other factions to meet their demands. Each such you add increases your diplomatic weight and can be used to force them to concede land, pay tribute, or even surrender.

There's plenty of content that can be added to a system like this, however, we only have so much time and energy, so we'll begin by working on the most important parts first and perfect what we have in future iterations. Naturally, we also want to add functionality interfaces so that you, our community, may expand upon what's there, by perhaps adding the ability for captives to break free from jail, or so that you may... do untoward things with those you've captured.

[h2]Can Captives Be Executed? Would That Make the World Empty?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/de186f06d878fb610fca7e8139206d3f1d0a3f56.png[/img]

A good question indeed. That's something we had plenty of discussions around before we even began developing this feature. To remedy this, we added in our last update the ability to auto-generate NPCs based on events. And we'll be adding a new set of families and NPC generation with the new version too.

As the months tick by, the world will once again bustle with life no matter how many NPCs you execute. However, newly generated NPCs are based on models and might only have access to a few set talents and skill pages, meaning that they'll be inferior to the original NPCs.

We estimate that this will become available for free with the next update.

[b][h2]Mod Workshop Support[/h2][/b]

The Mod Workshop has been and always will be an integral part of Sands of Salzaar. And so, without further ado, we'll be providing more tools and support. In this version, we'll incorporate most FGUI menus to Expert mods, giving you the ability to edit the design and change assets for almost every menu. We'll also make available configurations for the base game's maps along with another batch of reference content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/c7a249cd987625ea1c2f84c925ae19373d89553a.png[/img]

The new mod editor will contain a function where you can upgrade simple mods to advanced ones. What's more, you'll be able to quickly make resource packs via a Unity editor from within the settings of advanced mods (you'll need to install any Unity dependencies for this to work).

GUI Location:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b9fa87af8f5711e9360efd4fa24bbd6135523514.png[/img]

But that's not all. During our work to adapt the game for multiple platforms and continued development, we've upgraded the game's Unity version. This has naturally caused changes to the game's Unity action models. While most older mods should still work, some advanced mods that contain actions for new characters might need to upgrade to the 2020.3.48 Unity version and repackage their asset packs.

To simplify this process, we're providing the ability to directly upgrade old advanced mods from within the editor. However, we'd still like to extend our apologies to all you modders out there for any inconvenience caused.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a044c1ca2515e25516060ea80da16d9ff2ebb180.png[/img]

Another thing that's been on our mind as of late, is the fact that each new update affects our mod community one way or another. Some mods might become unavailable until a fix is released, or even worse, mods where the authors have discontinued update support may become unusable entirely. Plus, every update also comes with its own bugs.

Our plan is that starting our next update with Captives, we'll provide stable access to old versions so that you may choose for yourself whether to use the latest version or an older one. This means that even as we update the game, you'll still be able to use the mods you've grown fond of.

Naturally, we won't have versions available for all the small updates that we make but only for major updates. We'll make sure to keep a branch available of each major patch going forward that should be compatible with most mods created during that time.

That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game!

notes.title: Update Log - [Further Lag Optimizations] [Map Changes] [New Tournament Content]
notes.content:
Travelers of the desert:

With the last updates, we've been making a range of adjustments to combat performance in the mid to late game, including:

●Restructured the code of our Tournament DLC to resolve progress blocks and some missing rewards;

●Reworked the logic behind combat text numbers to remedy combat lag in the mid to late game;

●Made changes to attack speed, improved attack hitboxes and the feel of attacks to further remedy lag and stutter in combat;

This time around, we've made changes to pathfinding logic and some map areas to remedy lag and stuttering experienced while exploring the map.

We've also further fleshed out the Tournament DLC with new content, and then we want to start a discourse with you, our players, regarding what other plans we have.

What's more, the base game will be available at 50% OFF and the DLCs at 33% OFF between Feb 4 and Feb 18 during the Spring Festival. 


[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

Most of our focus for the last while has been on improving mid and late-game performance. However, such changes often require us to make changes to the underlying code and we have to break down and tackle each issue at a time.

Following our changes to improve performance in combat, we'll now be putting our focus on the map, as that is an area regarding which we have received plenty of feedback. These include:

●[b]NPC Generation[/b]:

Improving the computing costs used for pathfinding when new parties are generated and optimizing some features to stabilize FPS while exploring the map;

●[b]Map Pathfinding[/b]:

We've realized that whenever you use auto-pathfinding to move on the map, the game will lag and the party's movement reset whenever you pass a pathfinding point. To solve this issue, we've improved the cooldown for movement resets and temporarily added motion slowdown to the camera to counteract the visual discrepancy of the movements.

●[b]Party Collision Calculations[/b]:

Previously when exploring the map, every party member would be computed as a collision target. This led to plenty of extra calculations being made and could also lead to you getting stuck on certain terrains.

We've reworked this, so that only the party leader is used for such calculations, effectively removing a lot of unnecessary computations and fixing some pathfinding issues.

●[b]Combat Maps[/b]:

To further fix such terrain issues, we've also removed and modified obstacles and collision zones on the two following maps:

[b]Redstone Valley[/b]: Removed most terrain obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ffbddd4bca2afefd16f356fc8fd326bfdaa53c79.png[/img]

[b]West Docana Desert[/b]: Switched the location and collision zone of the stone pillars that previously blocked the view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/879a4a0f2072ddca796ba65aebc86582d9a754a1.png[/img]

●[b]Siege Pathfinding Optimization[/b]:

 reworked the pathfinding logic on siege maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/106c73ada74b055a952d8fb862339d3fab9695c0.png[/img]

[h2]New Tournament Content[/h2]

While the Tournament does grant the winner a ton of rewards, you are unlikely to achieve victory in the early to mid-game. To smoothen out the overall experience, we've added two new tournaments with this update: Trials and Showdown.

·Trials: A tournament that can be held in any type of town. Speak to the Arena Keeper to start a round of 3v3 battles. You can take on this tournament as many times as you'd like, with the victor taking home some gold.

·Showdown: A tournament which is held in any town that is not a village every once in a while. While similar to the Tournament itself, this one is fairly frequent, but is smaller in scale and offers less handsome rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ab8b5f4a056b7ced32aeb302e502f49c3f1a5a15.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/adba2b8d8f12d87e7b32f47ced519dd697266a11.png[/img]

Captives Preview
In the current build, once you defeat an enemy army, they will be able to rebuild a large army in just a few days and begin attacking you anew. This has led to overly frequent battles in the late game. Plus, 
war has been the only means with which to annihilate your foes once and for all. Tons of repeated battles in a short amount of time have had an overall negative impact on the experience.

To remedy this, we are thinking of adding a mechanic called Captives in a future update, and would like to discuss our inspiration and ideas for this with you all:

·Once you've defeated an enemy army, you capture their hero and may choose to persuade or execute them.

·Once you've defeated an enemy army, you capture their soldiers and you may then choose to sell them for a ransom or force them to join your cause.

·Add a Prison to the town.

·To capture the enemy's leader and force them to cease their hostilities or surrender.

Apart from the aforementioned, we also have other ideas which we're considering. Anyway, it would mean the world to us if you left your valuable feedback in the comment section below!

That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game!

notes.title: December 8: All-Time Lowest Price & New DLC "Land of the Eclipse"
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! As of December 8th, our limited-time discounts have officially kicked off across all platforms, lasting until December 22nd. Notably, the Steam platform offers an unparalleled 60% OFF on the Sands of Salzaar base game – an all-time low!

Today marks the highly anticipated release of our latest DLC, "Land of the Eclipse"! This comprehensive DLC unfolds into three distinct chapters: "Eclipse Hive" introduces an exhilarating Boss challenge system, "Exotic Wayfarer" brings forth captivating character customization, and "Siege and Conquest" elevates the intensity of siege gameplay.

To celebrate the release, the new DLC will be available at a 33% discount. Both "The Tournament" DLC and "The Ember Saga" DLC will also see a new all-time low price with a 50% OFF discount.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621910/


[h3][b]"Land of the Eclipse" DLC Highlights:[/b][/h3]

[b]Exotic Wayfarer:[/b]

[list]
[*]48 new captivating character customization options (eyes, ears, nose, mouth, body, and hairstyles).
Introduces 8 new protagonist models corresponding to the newly added body options.

[*]Activating this content rewards you with the "Mirror Bead," an enchanting item for unlimited facial transformations.
[/list]

[b]Eclipse Hive:[/b]

[list]
[*]Presents a thrilling Boss challenge mechanism. Discover "Clues" from dungeons in every region, trade them with the "Mastigure Adventurer" for intel, and challenge potent Bosses for legendary gear.
[/list]

[b]Siege and Conquest:[/b]

[list]
[*]Reinvents siege battles by replacing the final line of defense with city walls, intensifying the visual spectacle and giving defenders a strategic advantage.
[/list]

If you’re more of a visual learner and find all this somewhat overwhelming, check out this hands-on video in which our friend Baby Boomer Gamer really hit the nail on the head with everything in Land of the Eclipse:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GUUiHBz086Y&ab_channel=BabyBoomerGamer


[h3][b]DLC Launch Celebration: Join the Giveaway in our Discord[/b][/h3]

As we celebrate the launch of our DLC and the festive season, we extend a warm invitation to all of you participate in our giveaway event for a chance to acquire one of the ten DLC keys. Dive into our Discord for comprehensive rules: https://discord.gg/xdindie

If you've got insightful tips, tricks, or helpful guides for the game that you think could make a difference for others, we’d love to have you sharing in the #tips-tricks-guides channel as well. 

[h3][b]"Land of the Eclipse" DLC Detailed Overview:[/b][/h3]

[b]Exotic Wayfarer: Gifts from Beyond the Desert[/b]

As tribal wars reach a stalemate, exotic merchants seize the opportunity, bringing caravans laden with goods to the Golden Market. They exchange goods for precious resources and introduce unique clothes and jewelry, offering a touch of exotic flair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/731d6cf8f4e45390633509868d79e9b066414707.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d250148c82da0eb2f4d6371d78a088d83cc28282.png[/img]

Upon entering the game, receive the "Mirror Bead," allowing on-the-fly character reshaping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/27fbb04fc5bfc73ed89899a90bdd425e99658eea.png[/img]


[b]Eclipse Hive: Formidable Enemies and Legendary Equipment[/b]

In the vast desert, a group of adventurers daily hunts monsters in the fearsome Land of Eclipse. These seasoned individuals challenge formidable enemies for the treasures they guard. With the new DLC, obtain “Eclipse Clues” from exploring dungeons to get a chance to challenge the bosses. High-difficulty dungeons will reward more clues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/bf01dd4ddb0e183b128bd1c9ab6bd0272fbf2b9a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d7e634387ba86390410d2dd053b1da505cb421ec.png[/img]

After obtaining the clues, go search around the major cities to look for the "Mastigure Adventurer" to submit them. For example, you will find one at the southeast of Frost Valley, in the Zagros Mountains.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/96841bf9d4b3f803a4d4dfdbcff30dad1b674850.png[/img]

As the precious "Intel" surfaces with the traces hidden in concealed clues, accumulating ten clues allows us to obtain the location details of the Boss from the Mastigure Adventurer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/96841bf9d4b3f803a4d4dfdbcff30dad1b674850.png[/img]

Subsequently, at the same location, delivering the "Intel" to the Mastigure Adventurer enables an immediate Boss challenge. Remember to exercise caution with these formidable creatures, significantly more powerful than past foes. Unlike before, in the Land of Eclipse, we can battle the Bosses with a certain number of troops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/4b3a37228375a2e7720a7db7394596084da598fa.png[/img]

After defeating the Boss, be sure not to forget to pick up your loot on the ground. Once you've collected the loot, you can return to the entrance of the Land of Eclipse, where a flag inserted into the ground will appear. Clicking on the flag allows you to exit the Land of Eclipse.

In the Eclipse Hive, there are a total of 36 legendary equipment pieces to acquire, with 24 regional Bosses available for challenges.


[b]Siege and Conquest: The Final Barrier to Defend Territories[/b]

Advancements in engineering lead to the construction of city walls, providing towns with a significant advantage against incoming foes. Now, archers can unabashedly hide behind these walls, unleashing arrows upon adversaries. Towns everywhere will boast city walls to defend against incoming threats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/65019a9c6b224d2d88ecf0eea838150172407858.png[/img]

City walls provide stationed units with additional attack range and damage resistance. Moreover, once the first and second defense lines are breached, the gates will close, preventing enemies from directly entering the stronghold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/52fe5a6436bc6ba61d74992512b87a03f8933793.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3b5c5c32b9f9c99f539d7ae8dc75f9f7625993cd.png[/img]

As previously announced, we've crafted wall models for the six major factions and the Fire Demon faction. Engage in siege battles in the game to fully experience this aspect.

[b]Known Issues[/b]

From previous tests, most issues have been resolved, with two exceptions to be fixed in the update soon after the DLC release:
[list]
[*]The Redstone Valley dungeon, "Giant Lava Cave" does not drop Eclipse Clues.
[*]In some cases, effects that increase attack speed become negative.
[/list]
Feel free to join our official Discord for discussions and assistance. Experienced players share insights, and the "Feedback" channel provides one-on-one communication for issue resolution.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you thoroughly enjoy the new content in the “Land of the Eclipse” DLC!

notes.title: Update Log - [Combat Improvements][Tournament Fixes][Editor Update][NewDLC Info]
notes.content:
Travelers of the desert:

We've fixed some of the bugs we told you about last week with the [Tournament] and [Child Rearing] in this update we just launched. We've also made some tentative improvements that'll hopefully reduce lag in the mid and late-game, and we've upgraded the mod editor.
This update hits PC and mobile at the same time, so be sure to update your client.

[h2][b][Combat Improvements][/b][/h2]

We continuously receive frequent feedback regarding lag in the mid and late-game, and it's something we've always needed to improve. We've seen that the most frequent lag occurs just as both sides' forces clash, and part of this is due to the combat text.

We've therefore made some changes to the underlying logic regarding this, which should alleviate some lag during late-game battles. Naturally, fully fixing this lag isn't something we can do with just one or two changes, and we'll be going at it from other directions too (such as AI pathfinding, etc.) once we've solved the issue with the combat text, to attempt to resolve this issue from multiple directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/9ab7010ed1014ce5b9b538cf35de62eb2217182c.png[/img]

And apart from this, we've taken the chance to make a few other changes too:
We've changed how critical hits are shown to make the visual prompts more intuitive, and we've differentiated magical and physical crits by giving them different colors.

We've also made changes to the attack speed and damage radius of all weapons. Attack speed now not only affects the cooldown of basic attacks, but also the animation speed along with both the fore and backswings. We've also changed the hitbox from its previous prismatic shape into a more intuitive conical shape.

[h2][b][Tournament Bug Fixes][/b][/h2]

Following the last round of changes, a few stubborn bugs still remained, which we've fixed this time around:

1. Fixed an issue where you couldn't participate in the Tournament again in the same town.

2. Fixed an issue where you would receive tournament rewards even if your team participated without you.

3. The game would suddenly freeze and the file become corrupt after a certain number of days had passed. We've now added protective measures to prevent this, which will automatically reset the Tournament DLC when this error occurs.

We've also fixed an issue a localization issue with the[b] [Child Rearing] [/b]DLC that led to a code error. The bug would lead to a key quest progressing into the wrong quest branch, meaning that the quest couldn't be completed.

Furthermore, we've redrawn all icons for special [Ember Workshop] gear and quest items.

Previous Version

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/f8678bc66f1dea737562d752f4b5f5ea16d766df.png[/img]

New Version

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/06912f0cc63f174168743c9d105e4017f1150df0.png[/img]

[b]We've also made the following fixes and changes in the new update:[/b]

1. Improved the underlying logic behind damage calculations.

2. Fixed a bug where the Might, Agility, Essence and Wisdom of skills weren't included in the final calculation.

3. Fixed a bug that would invalidate strategy order configurations.

4. Divided up the difficulty further, allowing for individual dynamic changes to level caps.

5. Added an attribute affix that increases Might, Agility, Essence and Wisdom by a certain percentage.

6. Adjusted the Block attribute affix, added Block and Counter Block, Empower Block and Weaken Block.

7.Added objects/areas which are only traversable from one side in battle.

[b]1.0.40 Temporary fixes[/b]

[b]Through immediate feedback from our community of players we've discovered some issues in version 1.0.40 that we've made temporary fixes for[/b]

1. Auto-battle can not be carried out
2. Unlimited duration of invincibility buffs
3. Cannot learn NPC skills

[h2][b][Editor Update][/b][/h2]

We've updated the mod editor to make it easier for mod creators to use it. This includes improving the UI and adding a few commands, along with three viewers: Icon Viewer, Portrait Viewer, and Model Viewer. Hopefully these changes will be of some help to you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/194f812d0adb779b5dcd5d7ebd96739641cde23b.png[/img]

Within the Icon Viewer you'll be able to find all icons currently available in the game. Considering that some icons are readily used, we've also added a batch of new ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/9fddab4879e534c628f039ca936142a4930ac3a1.png[/img]

Within the Portrait Viewer you'll be able to find all portraits and avatars currently available in the came. These are marked with a corresponding portrait ID, so that you can more easily change out default portraits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/caa578160e4dd48c752f5bfbe569ddfa66b03144.png[/img]

Within the Model Viewer you'll be able to find all character models currently available in the game. You can also directly drag weapons in the object category to the right to see their animations and special effects.

[h2][b][New DLC Info][/b][/h2]

We revealed a preview of the new DLCs we're working on last week, and we've naturally received feedback regarding this. We'll just say it: the DLC is coming on Dec 8, just as there are discounts running on the various platforms.

[h3][b]Exotic Wayfarer[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/842211ff3670472fff70c46f5ebd6397f532b9ac.png[/img]

The Exotic Wayfarer DLC will include outfits inspired by a variety of cultures, along with uniquely colored hairstyles. This DLC will also come with an item granting one free character customization (cannot be used to change gender), enabling you to change your appearance without first talking to the dresser.

[h3][b]Siege and Conquest[/b][/h3]

Following our DLC reveal, plenty of you were worried that soldiers getting stuck in walls would become an even greater problem than before. And that's indeed one of the issues we encountered during development. We tried to fix this in a variety of ways, including changing the display size of models for broader paths, and modifying collision body sizes and map boundaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ae4a6055dd2e124671eca17e02bbdcc7f32b89b6.gif[/img]

We ended up using the aforementioned in part, and put most of our focus on modifying AI pathfinding. The pathfinding guideline we've added for siege battles should prevent this issue to some extent. Plus, this change will improve the issues of soldiers getting stuck in walls for the base game too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/07a0d7e0ee3aaceed285760c910cbfc03dbf04a7.png[/img]

We have created a set of city walls and gates with unique designs that differ for all regions (Ifrit Domain, Redstone Valley, Crying Rock, Twinluna Valley, Zagros Mountains, Umbra Cliffs, West Docana Desert). Have a look at our early design drafts!

As for which designs will prevail and how they'll look in the game when released, well, you'll just have to find that out later!

[h3][b]The Eclipse Hive[/b][/h3]

We mentioned in the preview that you could gather Eclipse [Clues] from the various regions and exchange these with the Mastigure Adventurer (usually found near the main city of the region's main faction) for [Boss Intel] in order to directly challenge that boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6888add39e7ad9d96dfd06870f56c23b656d2b10.png[/img]

We've created 24 bosses for The Eclipse Hive, with each region apart from the Ifrit Domain containing 3 powerful entities and 1 super entity. Each of these has different mechanics from ordinary bosses.

As an example, the Twinluna Valley's super boss will in phase two pit you against a clone of yourself (with your skills, gear and attributes, but naturally with more skills due to being an AI).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/31fd076bfd541b7690a9d5e4ad458e08517d2a8a.png[/img]

Or when faced with the Dune Band trio, you must defeat all of them within quick succession of one another or they'll simply resurrect to no end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b85340f882bb5586dc34f57fc5205e5079f3759b.png[/img]

Upon defeating a boss in the Land of the Eclipse, their loot will drop as a chest upon the ground. Be sure to leave the area only AFTER you pick up your loot. There's a confirmation box for leaving, though, so there's that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/2e7cc486f272703d03b1970178281d2e6fb16eba.png[/img]

For the 24 bosses in the 6 regions, we've created 36 pieces of legendary gear all featuring gear skills. Each boss has a 100% chance of dropping a unique piece of gear of a set gear slot, while each super boss has a 100% chance of dropping 1 out of 3 pieces (accessory, armor or weapon).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a434f701afda7ac44c03e6dd5789b627b213fd5e.png[/img]

These new pieces of gear aren't just powerful stat sticks, rather, they all have their own quirky effects and mechanics that may be either good or bad. But when used properly, a seemingly bad effect may well be a great one.

[h2][b]New DLC Release Date & Discounts[/b][/h2]

The new DLCs are estimated to hit the stores on Dec 7, 10:00 PST. The Sands of Salzaar base game will be available at a discount for 2 weeks (Dec 7 to 21).
The PC discount will be our biggest ever at 60% off for the base game, and 50% off for both The Ember Saga and Tournament DLCs.

[b]That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game![/b]

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 & New DLC Preview!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings![/b]

From the enchanting dunes to the mystic ruins, our journey together in Sands of Salzaar has been nothing short of magical - thanks largely to your incredible support! It's the stories you've lived, the battles you've fought, and the communities you've built within the vast desert landscape that have transformed this game into a living, breathing world.

[b]As Steam Awards 2023[/b] nominations are now underway, we'd be so grateful if you would consider nominating Sands of Salzaar for the [b]Labor of Love[/b] category. It means so much more than just recognition, but also a celebration of the journey we've shared! Our regular updates, introducing new quests, characters, and gameplay systems, alongside the thriving modding community, stand as a testament to our dedication and your unwavering support.

There’s an added perk too! By completing all the Steam Awards tasks during nominations, you can earn a special Steam Awards Nomination Committee Badge. It's a cool symbol of your engagement and love for the gaming community.

If Sands of Salzaar has been a part of your gaming highlights, we’d be thrilled to read your reviews on Steam. Your insights are windows into your experiences and a guiding star for our future updates and expansions.

Again, thank you all for being the heart of Sands of Salzaar. Let's continue to spin tales of adventure, mystery, and camaraderie in the sands of our beloved world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/978e27fb4a0c3fb9720a67a436d5b28ee0874262.png[/img]


[h2]What comes NEXT[/h2]

In our recent update, we rectified a multitude of issues that had been hurting "The Tournament" experience, we hope the fixes would have improved your enjoyment in Sands of Salzaar. For lingering challenges that require a more nuanced approach, we've been actively experimenting and will address them in our next update. 

Today, we're going to take this chance to talk more about our plans, thoughts on the game, and introduce the upcoming DLC, "Winter of the Hazy Realm."

Updates

[b]Refining "The Tournament": [/b]
Expect adjustments to "The Tournament" as we tackle existing issues, fine-tune problems with specific rewards, and iron out bugs that prevent players from repeatedly participating in The Tournament. We're also contemplating the addition of more diverse and enticing reward types.

[b]Optimizing Late-Game Team Battles: [/b]
As the large-scale late-game team battles unfold, we've noted instances of frame drops and stutters. After meticulous performance analyses, we've identified that the bottleneck lies in the batching of damage/recovery text. The next version will have optimizations implemented in this regard, along with enhancements to the visibility of critical hits for a clearer gaming experience.

[b]Revamped Mod Editor: [/b]
Our mod authors, the stalwart pillars of the "Sands of Salzaar" community, have been a driving force. We will bring a fresh new look to the editor in the upcoming update, anticipate a revamped UI for the editor, complemented by additional built-in features such as a character portrait viewer and an icon viewer.


December DLC "Winter of the Hazy Realm" Preview

This exciting new DLC scheduled for this December unfolds in three distinct parts: "Mysteries of the Hazy Realm," "Foreign Travelers," and "Siege and Conquest."

[h3]Confronting Challenging Bosses and Gaining Abundant New Equipment - "Mysteries of the Hazy Realm"[/h3]

The term "Hazy Realm," coined by Sand Lizard scholars, refers to the nests of monsters. These elusive nests, akin to mirages, house coveted ancient texts, magical creatures, and deadly monsters. Enterprising adventurers, often audacious members of the Sand Lizard Explorer's Guild, risk their lives scouring the desert for treasures and texts sought after by scholars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/664da93f4d98bf4061c8b41602ff5fe600abad8d.png[/img]

Traces of these daring adventurers are scattered across the desert. By providing clues obtained from local mysteries, players can procure intelligence from these adventurers. Submitting this intelligence triggers a guided journey led by the adventurer directly to the boss of the Hazy Realm. A successful defeat results in powerful weapons and equipment as rewards.


[h3]Experiencing Exotic Clothing and Accessories - "Foreign Travelers"[/h3]

Caravans of merchants from distant lands converge at the Golden Market, offering a plethora of exotic clothing and accessories. During character creation, players can adopt character models that seamlessly align with the aesthetics of these outfits. Furthermore, at the commencement of the game, players can choose an unlimited-use disguise tool during the inheritance phase, allowing them to reshape their appearance at their whim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/86106e6183339c63e17405af1943cd520366d0df.png[/img]

[h3]Enhanced City Defense in "Siege and Conquest"[/h3]

Despite being on the defensive, facing what seems like an insurmountable situation, players are forced into direct conflict with the enemy. While arrow towers provide some support, their output proves inadequate against the relentless tide of oncoming enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/42c087c94a513db2e54e72ebe5f1fec4219ede33.png[/img]

In the new city siege mode, the final defense line of the base transforms into a fortified structure with a gate. Archers can take their positions on the wall, gaining strategic advantages. After breaching the gate, enemies must engage in combat at the entrance before having an opportunity to capture the city.

Moving forward, we're committed to advancing the development of the upcoming DLC and will soon share more concrete details with all of you. Before the official debut of the new DLC in December, we're planning a round of small-scale testing very soon. If you're eager to get involved, feel free to sign up within our official group. Your participation and feedback are invaluable as we shape this exciting new chapter!

[b]That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game![/b]

notes.title: September Update - [DLC: Tournament Code Refactoring]
notes.content:
[b]Greetings![/b]

There have been several issues with [DLC: Tournament]: missing rewards; the player is unable to start the tournament; the game freezes if a mirror player team joins the tournament, etc. Therefore, we have spent some time restructuring the code of DLC: Tournament and optimizing the text logic to simplify the interactive dialogues with the tournament host.

After testing, this update supports loading save files from v1.0.32 and may not be compatible with some mods. We will be porting this update to other platforms soon.

[h2][b]Tournament Launch Logic Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/84ac81258ed03c2922df6e4bd2f219040edc2a74.png[/img]
Prior to this update, tournaments are launched in certain towns in random orders after the player meets a series of complicated conditions, which lowers the possibility of joining a tournament. In the new version, tournaments are launched separately in specific regions and towns, meaning that tournaments will be held more frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/715259fe53d0ad5a62aa43c6074b89c1eebe86f7.png[/img]
Therefore, there will be no more pop-up notifications on the right side of the screen that are easy to miss. In the new version, the player can talk to the Tournament Registrar in any town to learn about available tournaments and which towns they are held in.


[h2][b]Tournament Rules Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/23c21a584cba88d6020ff91d3d2fd03223c61731.png[/img]
In the new version, we have adjusted the logics of tournament participation: participants are no longer required to be present now. Meanwhile, the player may pay a small amount to expedite a tournament, where stand-ins will substitute for missing participants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/44de466d655e01b836e7b1a49680fe33cde37507.png[/img]
In the early stage of the game, the player may request to join a participant's team, but the request will be rejected if there isn't enough Favor.

[h2][b]Spectating and Betting Optimizations[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3176c05d9bc24cb8c7ffc9e5529a8d7d3f51455b.png[/img]
There are some issues with the tournament spectating feature in the old version, so we have adjusted the code, changing the previous null model angle into an actual camera angle.

In addition, we have reworked the betting feature so that the player may bet in a tournament that they haven't joined for Gold.

[b]That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game![/b]

notes.title: Expanded Update Child Rearing-Expanded Story,Champion of Chaos-Sub-class Fixe +
notes.content:
[b]Greetings![/b]

We've further expanded upon [Child Rearing] with this update, and you can now raise a child as a mother! We've also fixed some [Champion of Chaos] skills that weren't working, and tuned down a few of the more imbalanced skills for an overall better experience.

This update mostly targets the DLC, meaning that we're not changing the version number for this. We'll push it onto other platforms soon too.

[h2][b]Child Rearing - Expanded Story[/b][/h2]

Having gathered feedback from you all, we've decided to expand upon the [Child Rearing] content. With this update, those playing as a female character will be able to take on the role of a 'Mother' and all the joy it brings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/1fc29c404dc33acfd70135576cda4df5ae22ef5f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a9ad87d6f2a3ca43efc3174296a7311203116386.png[/img]

The story parts of child rearing are unique for female and male characters. A female character will be able to interact with their child to a greater extent, and even more story dialogue will be triggered if the child's father is also in the party.

[h2][b]Champion of Chaos - Sub-class Fixes + Skill Changes[/b][/h2]

[b]Sub-Classes[/b]

[b][White Rose Medic][/b]

1. White Rose Potion, Healing Remedy & Emergency Healing - Corrected the descriptions.
2.  Heal & Revive - The skill now takes effect. Removed its erroneous trigger conditions and corrected its description.
3. Private Healer - The skill now takes effect.
4.Health Regen Potion - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the description.

[b][Merchant][/b]

1. Selling On the Go, Jadeware Comprador & Hauling Bag - Corrected the descriptions.
2. Glib Tongue - The skill now takes effect. Corrected its description and altered its power.
3. Good Business Opportunity & Goods Peddling - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the descriptions.
4. Establishing Contacts - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party, or triggering an event after a dialogue will have them join your party. Adjusted the description and return time (7 days → 2 days).

[b][Blacksmith][/b]

1. Ore Mining & Logging - Corrected the descriptions.
2. Glib Tongue - The skill now takes effect. Corrected its description and altered its power.
3. Weapon Repair - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Repair now has a 3-day cooldown.
4. Armor Maintenance - Now increases the Physical Damage Reduction of all heroes in the battle based on the skill's level (5%/level).
5. Weapon Sharpening - Now increases the Physical Attack of all heroes in the battle based on the skill's level (5%/level).
6. Gear Enhancement - Also takes effect for characters with the skill that are not in your team or faction. Fixed - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the cooldown (free once every 7 days → free once every 15 days).
7. Weapon Rumors - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Changed the skill name (Weapon Rumors → Weapon Forging) and the description. Adjusted the cooldown (every 7 days → every 15 days), and added more possible gear types (4 types in total → 3 of every weapon type).
8. Weapon Refinement - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. No longer copies the item refined. Adjusted the dialogue and fixed a bug where canceling the refinement would still put the skill on cooldown. Adjusted the description and the cooldown (every 7 days → every 3 days).

[b][Alchemist][/b]

1. Mass Regen Potion & Hemostatic Dressing - Corrected the descriptions.
2. Herb Gathering - Corrected the description and increased the number of herbs (3 → 15).
3. Potion Crafting - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Replaced the Potion Crafting list and adjusted the description.
4. Medicine Concoction, Potion Brewing & Supreme Elixir - These skills can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the descriptions.

[b][Recruiter][/b]

1. Rousing Speech - Adjusted the skill effect and description. The skill now grants EXP to one squad every 3 days.
2. Gathering of Heroes - Adjusted the skill effect and description. A low-cost squad now joins every 7 days.
3. Journey Recruitment - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the description.
4. March Efficiency & Veteran's Guidance - Corrected the descriptions.
5. Mercenary Snakehead & Worldly Wisdom - This skill can only trigger while the character is in your party. Adjusted the descriptions.
6. Arduous Journey - Adjusted the skill effect and description. There's a low chance that a high-level squad joins every 7 days.

[b]Hero Skill Changes[/b]

1. [Spell Barrier] - Fixed a bug where this passive fully restores your mana when hit.
2. [Shoryuken·Zen] - Fixed an issue where the follow-up basic attack Shoryuken would override and nullify the first basic attack hit.
3. [Stratosphere] - Fixed an issue where switching with this skill had a chance to get stuck and prevent you from changing back again.
4. [Law of Life of Gold] - Fixed an issue where this passive didn't take effect.
5. [Fatal Slash] - Fixed a bug that prevented the skill from working.
7. [Treasure Thief] - Fixed a bug where there was only 1 gift.
8. [Shadow Dart] - Fixed a bug where this skill didn't increase in power with its skill level.
1. [Sword Oath] - Fixed a bug where this skill didn't increase in power with its skill level.
2. [Teasing of the Rich] - Fixed a bug where this skill didn't increase in power with its skill level.
3. [Gold Begets Gold] - Added a limit to how much Gold it can grant.
4. [Winter's March] - Fixed a bug regarding Ice Bolt hit counts.
5. [Time Shelter] - Fixed a bug where Najima would become impervious to damage right from the start.
6. [Future Foreshadowing] - Fixed a bug that prevented the passive from working.

[b]Other Changes[/b]

1. Fixed a bug with Jamilla's weapon types.
2. Fixed a bug where Agura started with the wrong weapon type.
3. Fixed a bug where NPCs could get DLC Tournament gear out of thin air.
4. Fixed an issue where the 5 new characters from the DLC Tournament didn't have damage calculations in their damage skill descriptions on their skill pages.
5. Fixed a bug where the CARD_SELECTOR command couldn't be used as intended.
6. Adjusted some of Ember Ocher's skill effects, and fixed some skill descriptions to make them easier to understand.

[b]That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game![/b]

notes.title: August Update - Batch Promotion and Disband, Anti-Invisible, MOD Editor Update
notes.content:
Hi desert travelers!

"Sands of Salzaar" has officially updated to version 1.0.32. This update mainly adds Batch Promotion and Batch Disband functions in the team interface, which can reduce various tedious operations. We also add anti-Invisible mechanics . In addition, we have expanded the functions of the MOD editor.

The current version for non-steam platforms will need to wait a little extra time due to some technical and censorship reasons,We will try our best to make up for the gap in update progress. We will communicate with everyone after we determine the details of the update.

[h2][b]Batch Promotion and Disband Function
[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/1237c8dd2ee9d038472097eeaae5303ce698bd60.png[/img]

In previous versions, if you wanted to promote multiple squad, you needed to repeat [[b]click unit→promote→upgrade[/b]] , which became particularly cumbersome when there were many squads needing upgrade. Also the same issue with Disband Function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/803174efcb5edfa1a0dd859003477a0038ae1641.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/abbc386d89a1295751aa0e5f1e52cc6cbad40629.png[/img]

In new version, you can promote soldiers in batches, quickly strengthening squads,  also you can using batch disband function to dismiss no needed squads.


[h2][b]anti-Invisible mechanics[/b][/h2]

"[b]Invisibility equals invincibility[/b]". In "Sands of Salzaar", there are many skills and equipment that include invisibility mechanics. When conditions allow, invisible units often wipe out an entire troop. To fix this issue, we will add some "anti-invisible mechanics" in new version.

[b]New consumable item—Ash of Appearance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/9a64384f9d71e0d75145b664732480c9d0cfaaff.png[/img]

After use, it reveals invisible enemies within 1200 cubits and forms a fog that lasts for 10 seconds, continuously revealing the invisible enemies within it.

[b]New skill of troop —Scent Hunter[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/759fa71d61221bdd7a6eaf2659914405f75073ec.png[/img]

Can attack invisible units; attacking will cause invisible units to reveal(not sharing vision with team).
Dhib Wolf, Arctic Wolf, Badland Wolf, Canis and their high tier units all gain this passive skill.


[h2][b]MOD Editor Update[/b][/h2]

The MOD editor that has accompanied players since EA, no it will be upgraded of providing better support for MODer. We are very grateful for all of ours contributor.
Thanks you guys! 

[b]Skill Editor Optimization[/b]

[b]Previous version[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/c4e6fd9f3b97fd4d1f026627b7493f9cdcb4a5c1.png[/img]


[b]New version[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/fac0c016ff518b4f902983e078659d0bbe77e8ea.png[/img]

In the new skill editor, multiple functions have been added: battlefield tab, real-time game logs display, role attributes and buff display, map switching. 

[h2][b]Other Updates[/b][/h2]

Backpack display—Added maximum number and used number display

Optimize the Squad upgrade material display—Now you can see the materials required for unit promotion.


That's all for this update! Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game!

notes.title: July Update: Child Rearing Expansion, New Ember Workshop Equipment
notes.content:
Hi desert travelers!

This new update contains optimizations and adjustments to the issues we promised to resolve in our previous announcement. 

We have also created an update plan for what’s in store for the Child Rearing DLC. After that, we will focus on fixing issues in the Tournament DLC. 

We are also considering adding functions such as batch upgrading and batch disbanding of soldiers. We will go into more detail about this in future announcements.

In addition, we are working on getting this update available on all platforms, and this will most likely be done by early August.

[h3][b]Here are the details of this update.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Updates to the Sands of Salzaar Base-Game[/b][/h2]

1. We have adjusted the base price of the trade permit to 250 utar (price increases with the number of days), and the price of the temporary trade permit to a fixed price of 25 utar. This change will greatly reduce the difficulty of trading in the early game. We will continue to make changes to trading to make it more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a9b9aaeaa26cdcc71db2a61f96bccedb4acfbb8c.png[/img]

2. Modified the favor level descriptions of heroes, places and tribes.

3. Modified the attack logic of the arrow tower.
We replaced the original homing arrows with a small ​​arrow rain, lowered the damage of explosive arrows, and optimized the tower’s performance. The brand-new tower is more threatening to clumped-up enemies, and while the explosive arrows deal less overall damage, they home in on enemies. Players can avoid the rain of arrows by rolling, and can recover life between explosive arrow hits, meaning that there’s more room for error (but the arrow tower still poses a high threat).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a5adcc9fa9d30859fd5695a7b4e71c31cafc3a52.gif[/img]

4. We have adjusted the initial favorability between The Nameless and various tribes to -30. We have also changed the threshold for when players become wanted by AI forces. When wanted, the heroes of that faction will chase the player; if they succeed in defeating the player, favorability is restored. When the favorability value exceeds the wanted threshold, the wanted player will be free to roam again (i.e., you can freely enter and exit that faction’s towns). This setting is however invalid for factions which the player are at war with.


[h2][b]Updates to The Ember Saga DLC[/b][/h2]

We have fixed some skill stats that were displayed incorrectly, as well as some errors with the text itself.
In addition, we have made other updates.

[h3][b]DLC Among Legends - Xin Qi Ji[/b][/h3]

Fixed a bug where the Ghostly Sacrifice made the caster dizzy.

[h3][b]DLC Ember Workshop[/b][/h3]

1. New Special Equipment
A new batch of equipment has been added that can be obtained by completing the Ember Workshop main quests. We have also adjusted the quantity of other rewards (such as jades, Ironstone, etc.) that can be obtained from the Heyan Workshop tasks. Here is a brief introduction to the new equipment: 

[b]Iron Arm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/e4b1b2958b827c401b8835d4df0bf37e152b84ba.png[/img]
This gauntlet once belonged to a sage of the Steel Guards. It has a great knockback effect.

[b]Longevity Armor [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3b428d64d0f6ec02cc1623499a2dd4e66107261a.png[/img]
The armor of the top fighters of the Vitalus Vitara. Living people wearing it will gain some negative effects, but they can persist in fighting for a period of time after their HP drops to zero.

[b]Immortal Scepter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/eb612e48fff0f2657a859dc226eb67660e064204.png[/img]
Any user using this to summon undead will be cursed forevermore.

[b]Godhammer of Ember[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/26db53a06544aa6131be4a762ddc6a14dd45ffc3.png[/img]
This artifact developed by the Ember Workshop is a warhammer that can switch between its "thunder" and "flame" forms, granting different skill effects based on the current form.

[b]Photovoltaic Storm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/201c7fb2c398cf0ea19b928d376178ba7690a71a.png[/img]
A mechanical short bow Ember Ocher made for herself. It has special attack effects and enhances her skills.

2. New Legacy
Fire Reincarnation: Choose this to skip the Ember Workshop plot and get special items rewards.

3. More Gems Refining
These gems can now also be refined: Wild Thing, Executioner, Keeper of Cliffs, Lord of Poisons, Wrath, Wild Downpour, Ransack, Insulation, Ancestor, Demise, Sheikh, Undying Faith, Excalibur.

4. Bug Fixes and Optimizations
-Fixed a bug that might cause some NPCs to activate erroneously when the player establishes a faction.
-Fixed a bug where Ember Ocher's Avid Mediator skill didn't take effect immediately when she acquires it or joins the team with it.
-Adjusted the effects of the Workshop Contact skill.
-A special skill page designed for Holtron. You can activate him through the new Fire Reincarnation.
-Optimized some combat missions to prevent the player from getting stuck.

[h3][b]DLC Child Rearing[/b][/h3]

1. Romance for All Heroes
All heroes can become the protagonist's love interest (including female protagonist romancing male teammates). Of course, some characters require certain conditions, such as: Jamila before the completion of the Ember Workshop plot and Zeynep before the resurrection in the story of the Spiritmancer, etc...

Love stories are affected by the hero’s character values. The most prominent of these will serve as the main value and will result in the hero being assigned to 1 of 8 different love storylines.
The plot features three phases that must be triggered while the love interest is in the team. Upon reaching a favorability of 70 or more, you can choose the option "Strike up a conversation", thus starting the first phase. The next two plots are triggered by the NPC after their favorability reaches the required amount.

2. Child Rearing of Female Heroes
When a male protagonist and a female hero become lovers, they can have children. A female hero, as opposed to tavern girls, instead receive a task called "Raising a Baby". The protagonist can then take her to any city to raise a child.
We would love to have completed parenting for female protagonists, but alas we have not. We will instead add this in an update in August as soon as possible. For now, female protagonists can gain a small attribute increase by interacting with their lover.

3. New Equipment
Rings of Love: Completing each love story route awards you a pair of special rings allowing the protagonist and their lover to cast combo skills.

[b]Rings of Love - Spring Breeze[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/e934d5e88c745ddee9910e3b8cd1da58e08bd20e.png[/img]

“Love is like a spring breeze; let a sea of flowers bloom in our hearts.”

[b]Rings of Love - Thunder Oath[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/fc46038f4579ba1936c1930c03214163435a804c.png[/img]

“Change your mind and you will be struck by lightning.”

[b]Rings of Love - Massive Rock[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6f5a8e0ffdc4b6a315fc0fcd081a3b3edf7df3dc.png[/img]

“My love for you is as eternal as a rock.”

[b]Rings of Love - Fox Charm[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d0a13ab5a9e0b399e2324b318fdaa40e08122885.png[/img]

“Although foxes are quirky, they only have one mate in their lifetime.”

[b]Rings of Love - Still Water[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6300eb5b7cd87fea1b1762cd4802205a2c0d1031.png[/img]

“The hearts of two lovers are like mirrors formed by still water, and in observing each other, they connect.”

[b]Rings of Love - Flying Flames[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/405b42a54d80165dfe732ced2c6524d50e68042d.png[/img]

“Love should be like a spark: it should be hot, it should fly.”

[b]Rings of Love - Morning Light[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/1e3977aff02e711a3cdc06fe2dfd40a25e29843b.png[/img]

“Love radiates morning light, dispels darkness, and brings hope.”

[b]Rings of Love - Unrealistic Dream[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/4219a3732e7d2d896656b1909f1c997681ff005a.png[/img]

“Great, you are like someone who just walked out of my dream...”

4. Fast Mode
Selecting this mode on the Legacy interface before starting a game will greatly shorten the cycle of childbearing.

5. New Protagonist
Inheritor: After the player's heir becomes an adult, he can be selected as the heir through the "About our relationship" option in the dialogue. Afterward, the player can select "Children" as the protagonist to start a new game.

[h3][b]Other Updates[/b][/h3]

1. Bug Fixes

-Fixed the gender setting error in the Rebiya's mode.
-Fixed an issue where heroes of a faction disappear when entering the cities of other factions.
-Fixed an issue where non-customizable characters were able to customize their appearance by returning from the Legacy screen.
-Fixed an issue where clicking the confirmation button may grant rewards multiple times in the battle victory interface.
-Fixed a bug where non-active talents could be deactivated.
-Modified crit calculations, fixing an issue where the damage that should not have critted no longer crits.
-Fixed a model misplacement bug that could occur when the characters on the arrow tower cast their skills.
-[Mobile Terminal] Fixed an issue where the character's attack during movement could cause the attack action to be played incompletely.

2. Optimizations

-It is now possible to save during battle.
-[Mod] Adjusted the mechanics of some triggers to provide Mod compatibility.
-[Steam] The full mod descriptions are now displayed in the creative workshop interface.
-[Mod] Adjusted the mod construction process. When creating a mod, it will automatically use INDEX_Source.xml to generate Index.xml and default.xml.
-Modified the shape of the unit collider to make the character move more smoothly.
-Adjusted the font color of mana recovery to make the difference between health recovery and mana recovery more obvious.
- [Mod] Adjusted the first_in trigger to trigger all events that should be triggered.

3. New Mod Functionality

-[Mod] New directive for the protagonist to leave the town/city.
-[Mod] New directive for whether to display daily food consumption.
-[Mod] Added a string parameter for SET_TIMER.
-[Mod] Added a series of new directives for modifying and querying character attributes.
-[Mod] Added an optional directive to select a follow-up shot for the ENTER_PLACE directive of MAP_CMD.
-[Mod] Added a query directive for querying additional attributes of characters.

We will continue to adjust and add more functionality to the mod editor in the future. This will be synchronized with the developer wiki.
Feel free to join our Discord to get in touch! Our managers will try their best to help you solve any issues you encounter in the game!

notes.title: Update Preview (Late July): [Trade Permits,Starting Relations][DLC Updates]
notes.content:
Hi desert travelers!

Based on the recent community feedback collected, we have initially formulated a long-term update plan. We expect the new update to be live on PC first during late July, and subsequently release them to other platforms when ready.

[h2][b][In-Game Mechanics Optimizations][/b][/h2]

[b]1. [Optimization] The price of a City Trade Permit has been reduced from 1,000 Utar to 200. Interim Trades are now 25 Utar.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/290770516051d058f7cbce975dcf07b021bcc179.png[/img]

*City Trade Permits were a little too expensive. There wasn't much point in their high price tag, and it slowed down player progress. This is just a small adjustment to the trade system, but we'll be seeing how things go and releasing further updates as time goes on, so as to improve the system as a whole.

[b]2. [Optimization] Certain starting relations between the protagonist and various factions have been optimized, so as to prevent players from getting repeated bounties on their heads early on in the game.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/57766d018d8be17044e213c2415de2ca8036c9c6.png[/img]

*Early-game content was too challenging: players were marked as wanted by various Sultans, the enemy constantly at their heels, and they'd have to try and sneak into cities to buy anything. This adjustment works to amend these issues, but we appreciate that difficulty comprises more than just starting relations. We'll continue to optimize this to prevent the frustration of Sultans surrounding you at every turn early on in the game.

[b]3. [Optimization] Adjusted turrets' siege attack logic.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6dc407d9ae3a9fce28febb1b24bee8e7926c6821.png[/img]

*Turrets were, on the whole, a little OP during siege battles. Their heavy damage and homing arrows posed a huge threat in the early game when your squad's still quite small, but they weren't much of a threat at all once your numbers grew. We'll be optimizing turrets in the days to come, making them less punishing in the early game but strong enough to work in the late game too. That said, we'll be ensuring their overall damage output remains essentially the same.

[h2][b][The Ember Saga DLC Updates, Optimizations & Bug Fixes][/b][/h2]

[h3][b] Among Legends - Xin Qi Ji[/b][/h3]
[Bug Fix] Fixed an issue where Ghostly Sacrifice could stun the user.
[Bug Fix] Fixed skill value display issues and text errors.

*We've been listening to all your thoughts and feedback on Xin Qi Ji's content. We've heard calls for Blade Triple skills, story content and exclusive gear; we'll be discussing this throughout our long-term updates lined up, and make changes as necessary.

[h3][b]Ember Workshop[/b][/h3]
[New Addition] We've added special equipment to the game. Get it from the Ember Workshop campaign quests.
[Optimization] We've adjusted the Ember Workshop campaign quests' resource rewards to be more reasonable.
[Bug Fix] Fixed an issue where adding skill points to Ember Ocher skill [Avid Mediator] or adding characters to the party could prevent the skill from taking effect immediately.
[Bug Fix] Fixed an issue where creating a faction could have an effect on the activity of NPCs within it.
[Bug Fix] Fixed skill value display issues and text errors.

*Certain rare resources were far more common in the Ember Workshop campaign than in the rest of the game. We've adjusted Ember Workshop resource rewards to address this imbalance, and introduced a brand-new set of special gears too. Obtain it from the original campaign quests! In the future, we'll be considering adding Ember Ocher and this new gear into Legacy.


[h3][b]Child Rearing DLC[/b][/h3]
[Optimization] We've expanded the potential spouses available: they're no longer limited to just allies, and now even include certain key characters, too.

These updates are set to release in late July, then roll out on all platforms.
Rest assured that this is only the start of our long-term update plan. We'll continue improving areas of the game that need work, and in the meantime, you're all welcome to join our official Discord to keep in touch:
[url=https://discord.gg/kfWAnYy6Dj][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ed7d5cf3cd9cc4e705c1c3312a50bd4fc32bdb4a.png[/img][/url]
