notes.title: Update Log 4-23 (Sorting Optimization & Cost Price Display)
Update Log 4-20 (Spirit Witch is Arriving)
notes.content:
G’day our desert travelers!

Since the last update, we’ve kept hearing feedback from y’all, and devoted our efforts to adding new content and optimizing the gameplay experience. Now please meet our new character Spirit Witch, together with new quest lines about NPCs Mathali and Umara, the inventory sorting functions and more!

[h3]Spirit Witch Coming to the Desert！[/h3]
Spiritmancer is always ranking one of the player-favorite roles, and we’ve kept receiving the expectation for adding a female Spiritmancer in-game from the community. And now our new heroine Spirit Witch is available in-game! For this time, players will be the apprentice of Storm Archmage, and the story follows the adventures for becoming the most powerful and skilled Spiritmancer. In addition to her all-new skill pages and storylines, you can explore a series of new gameplay elements exclusive to this character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/f3b772ff6426aa370351a8714628fcf563b6de0d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a0b3ef4bc4352b4e951278c1cdb10be96bdb777e.gif[/img]

By playing the role of Spirit Witch, you are able to randomly skip the combat with bandits by using her arcana, or, recruit them as your troop. Also, you could have fun with her skill of crafting various potions with items in your inventory at the later stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/f68274596908b5ddb20384f678a90a1a234a26b4.gif[/img]

In addition to featuring the new character in-game, here come new quest lines of NPCs Mathali and Umara for you to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/64a1e46f47ec9668ba1f5c15092106b418836ca8.gif[/img]

[h3]Pack Up Everything Nicely[/h3]
Since we continuously received feedback that the sorting function in the inventory is highly expected among the players, by restructuring the inventory system and making lots of changes on the user interface, items now are sorted by types and much more clear to view items in your bag. And especially, we designed a storage area for travelers' food items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/2ae966f40de85f0e1b2fc434a8fb001ff09d3a4e.gif[/img]

[h3]No More Getting Lost[/h3]
In addition to having your bag better organized, we optimized the quest index as well. Travellers now are able to view and track the quests by clicking “L” as the default hotkey. The compass mark on the mini-map will help tell your current tracking quest with its location info.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/65cc51128e0352e1b5b0f0e07109b8834958ff6f.gif[/img]

And lastly, as our following roadmap, we will commit to achieving a major update including more character stories and side quests. We are also planning to work on enabling playing with controllers, optimization on the gameplay, more interaction with NPCs and other contents that are highly anticipated by you guys, and will share our future development plan with you promptly.

As always, you are welcome to report the in-game issues encountered or give any your suggestions for Sands of Salzaar, join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/xdindie]Discord[/url] or contact us through indie@xd.com.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/xdindie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d9f505e53b3db86b20976be03ee6e2a440458716.png[/img][/url]

For more details of this update, please read the patch notes below:

[h3]2021-4-20 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.3.1)[/h3]

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the new character Spirit Witch with all-new skill pages, storylines, and a series of new gameplay elements.
[*] Added sidequests of NPCs Mathali and Umara.
[*] Added new portraits and models for Spirit Witch and Spiritmancer.
[*] Reworked skill pages of Berserker.
[*] Added a Repair button to the interface of locations. Click this button to enter the Repair interface. In this interface, you can repair all or a single gear by buying necessary materials and resources.
[*] Added a special food inventory system which expands the old inventory with an additional section specially used to store food items. Food items will be automatically moved to these food slots until filled. When trading or storing food items, players can drag and drop food items from the food slots to the normal inventory slots for further actions. When actions are completed, the rest of the food items will be automatically moved back to fill the food slots.
[*] Added the hotkey to open the Quest interface on the map.
[*] Added team BUFF for consuming certain food and adjusted food prices.
[*] Added models for several capitals in Redstone Keep and Crying Rock with three different tiers.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced cooldown values of consumables that could be used during combat.
[*] Fully adjusted the prices of gears and relevant resources for repairing gears.
[*] Adjusted durability of certain gears in-game and added more types of items sold in capitals.
[*] Now all those medicines for recovery can be bought in major cities. 
[*] Reset the Inventory UI and trading UI with the new GUI framework, adding functions like categories to sort items in the Inventory.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing collision layer of a rock in the east of Redstone Keep.
[*] Fixed a few errors in English translation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Log 2-23 (Siege System Balance)
notes.content:
Hi guys, 

Happy New Year of the Ox! 

Our dev team has been back to work after the holiday leave with another new update available now! This update 0.8.2.2 is to patch up the issues players encountered in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1094520/view/3044965941455803560]last major update[/url] and adjust the new siege system for a better gameplay experience for y’all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/20b396eb0ac13517e9b4648ef5c57173ee145ad4.png[/img]

Since the last content update, we’ve been receiving some feedback from players that the new siege system is too challenging due to factors like high damage dealt by defending towers and unbalanced numbers of respawn times between the defenders and the attackers. Therefore, we tweaked the damage values of the turret towers and siege weapons as well as limited the number of respawn times of the player and the NPCs on the defending side for a more balanced siege combat system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/f8ef0564893cbc84a036269ad345028c7af5e213.png[/img]

In addition to this game patch, we are currently working on another content update, featuring a new character with dedicated storylines and more. Please also stay tuned!

For more details in this update, you could read the full patch notes below. As usual, if you have further issues or feedback, join our [url=https://discord.gg/xdindie]Discord[/url] server or send us an email to indie@xd.com.

[url=https://discord.gg/xdindie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d9f505e53b3db86b20976be03ee6e2a440458716.png[/img][/url]

[h3]2021-2-23 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.2.2)[/h3]
[b]New Addition: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added the feature of increasing damage to buildings for a few weapons. 
[/list]
[b]Adjustment: [/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the effect of Strength Elixir to control resistance. Now it can temporarily make the player resistant to all control effects for 8s. 
[*] Changed the number of times of resurrecting defending heroes to 5 times. 
[*] Removed The stun effect of Turret Tower and reduced the damage of Explosive Arrow. At the same time, the attack power of Turret Tower is reduced by 20%. 
[*] Hugely increased the damage of siege weapons to buildings and replaced the burning special effect of Ballista Fire Arrow.
[*] Adjusted the attribute value of characters controlled by the player in specific battles in accordance with the difficulty level of the game to avoid the situation that the enemies are too op to be defeated in the battle of high difficulty. 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing description of the skill "Call Heroic Soul" of the weapon Broken Sword - First Snow.
[*] Fixed the dialogue error of conversations with the siege weapon maker in the English version. 
[*] Fixed the bug where the companions were unable to learn Ice Arcana level 3.
[*] Fixed the bug where Berserker Jump Cut could not trigger the Resilience effect.
[*] Fixed several textual errors in the English version.
[*] Fixed the bug where closing the equipment fixing window would directly skip the fixing for this time and start the monthly cooldown for the next time in the blacksmith quest in Fleur (and in other quest events that use this command).
[*] Fixed the bug in mods where the character's gender was locked as male when it should be female.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Log 2-5 (New Siege Mode, Profession Redo and More)
notes.content:
Greetings Travelers! 
The new content update of Sands of Salzaar is finally here! Apologies for the delay in the planning to have this version released in Jan. However we believe you will find it is worth waiting.

After the last major update, in addition to regular bugfix and hotfix, we have devoted all our efforts to the reconstruction of the Siege Mode and the design of new professions. Right now, the new Siege Mode has been completed and goes live. We hope that this upgraded siege system will bring you more gameplay strategies and fun in the later stage of the game. As for the new profession, it will be officially released after March. Please also stay tuned!
As always, if you encounter any issue in-game, contact us through indie@xd.com, or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/xdindie]Discord[/url].

[url=https://discord.gg/xdindie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d9f505e53b3db86b20976be03ee6e2a440458716.png[/img][/url]

[b]New Siege Mode[/b]

In the new siege system, we have added infrastructures such as arrow towers and camps to the siege map. If you already own a land, you can build a “siege weapon” camp in the town. Different defensive towers can also be built, such as frost towers and scattering towers. Players can build different defensive towers depending on different regions their towns are located in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/cbcdd0381cc70a98ea4388e62aee711127af796d.gif[/img]

At the same time, the entire siege warfare rules have been reconstructed: The offensive NPC or player will have 2 chances of resurrection, while the defensive NPC or player can have unlimited resurrection opportunities. In addition, the minions cannot be respawned in the new siege mode, which will challenge the player's strategies and game skills even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/acb580127d62dac792f7f3ac3e78366b3faccd81.gif[/img]

[b]Profession Redo, Witchcraft for NPC[/b]

The skills of Hyena and Sentinel have been reworked, together with some new cool special effects added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/f50e32bd1365cf0dde5404305ce3203791d6eb27.gif[/img]

Also, in old versions, if an NPC with a high level has learned all its own skills, the extra skill points can only be wasted. However, this update has equipped arcana talent for every NPC, and now you can take NPC to learn witchcraft from those witchcraft masters in every town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ab9a628842400103a7411be0ecce43dcba059e10.gif[/img]

[b]Units AI Upgrade, Automatic Combat for Encounters[/b]

As some of you reported that the siege units won’t attack the next stronghold after they’ve occupied one, we have upgraded the AI of these units to make them more flexible on the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/148a735328cd919335153e3dbb4920451c08c1ad.gif[/img]

Also, when encountering combat in the desert, players can now choose either to lead troops to fight, or to fight automatically. Please note that the auto combat option can only be available when you turn on the new Real Injuries mode in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ff28d29c9e1504a71ec17537e16e4f696b2faf34.gif[/img]

In addition to the above updates, we have also resolved a couple of issues that our English players are most concerned about, such as adding the skip dialogue option and enabling the player's camera to free-roam the map after the character is defeated. For details on more adjustments and bug fixes in-game, please check the full patch notes below:

[h3]2021-1-30 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.2.1)[/h3]
[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added and replaced new siege modes and maps (if MOD authors want to use the new siege mode, they need to change the siege mode to "capture mode" in the corresponding siege war map settings to take effect), new rules linked with siege weapons, defense towers, barracks, warehouses and other buildings, and external town construction. In the new siege mode, heroes from both sides can be resurrected, but the resurrection time is extended, and each hero of the siege party has only two chances to resurrect.
[*] Added a new Real Injuries mode for our hardcore players. Now you can choose between the new and the old mode at the beginning of the game.
[*] Added auto-battle feature for encounters (note: the auto-battle option of encounters is only available when the new Real Injuries mode is turned on).
[*] Added an auto-skip button in the conversation interface (this function is only valid for continuous dialogue commands, and will automatically terminate when encountering non-dialogue commands).
[*] Added lots of new equipment icons.
[*] Adjusted stats of most equipment and added descriptions for them.
[*] Adjusted entry values ​​and descriptions, added some new entries. Most of the previous errors and descriptions of entries that were not displayed have been fixed.
[*] Reworked the Hyena skill page, balanced the values, and replaced Rocket Rain with SwitchBlade.
[*] Reworked the skill page of Sentinel, added a series of shield-type skills, and removed skills like Enlarge and Hook that do not match the character settings.
[*] Replaced the models of Hina and Nura.
[*] Added models for Batu, Princess Bellen, Fadia, Tasha.
[*] Added the definition of armor type.
[*] NPCs now have an arcana talent level, and they can be assigned to major arcana learning sites!
[*] The special effect position type in the BUFF table added the position type parameter for special effect positions of the left and right hand.
[*] Players can now choose whether to open the Land of Ifrit in a certain period of time at the beginning of the game (no need to complete the main storyline).
[*] Added a simple MOBA PVP multiplayer MOD under MOD samples (SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\DesertLegend\ModSamples\MultiplayerMod).
[*] Added two new points of interest related to siege weapons near Redstone Keep and Diresprings.   
[*] Added a NPC with warehouse function and backpack expansion in the spawn point of Redstone Keep.
[*] Players can now join the AI camp and can be granted as a Sultan. The probability and quantity of grants are related to the relationship between the forces and the number of territories the player has obtained. The more territories obtained, the lower the probability of granting.
[/list]
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the mana cost and damage values of some skills, nerfed some skills that were too overpowered, and buffed some skills that were too underpowered.
[*] Minor adjustment for the skill pages of some heroes.
[*] Increased the distance between the initial points of the two sides on several small battlefield maps.
[*] Adjusted the talent tree values.
[*] Adjusted monster types in some dungeons.
[*] You can now choose to retreat in a siege. 
[*] Enabled free-roaming camera that allows players to observe the battlefield freely after death.
[*] Minor adjustments for the interaction value between weapons and armor.
[*] The dialog box of the leader will no longer pop up when wages are paid for working for factions.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem where the AI automatic battle result judgment might be abnormal.
[*] Fixed the bug where the basic attack skill field of the specified character in the character configuration table failed abnormally.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI would not automatically attack the next stronghold during a siege.
[*] Fixed an issue where some sound effects played too many simultaneously.
[*] Removed the invalid reminder of "goods are hard to sell".
[*] Fixed the problem where bleeding did only 1 damage.
[*] Fixed the problem where Rusen’s conversation disappeared when the Rusen quest was completed.
[*] Fixed a bug where switching of non-weapon equipment during battle might not cause attribute changes.
[*] Fixed a bug where Legendary Blacksmith could not perform basic attacks.
[*] Fixed the bug where the basic attacks of harp, bow and sub-weapon were not considered as long-range attacks.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Update 1-29 (New Siege System Preview)
notes.content:
Hi, our desert travelers. A late happy new year to ya’ll! We are glad to share with you that there’s another major update upon us that will be live on Feb. 5th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/420835407ebfd96f7573ed614b0fedd085e18b57.gif[/img]

In this content update, we reworked the siege system, adding more elements of tactics to offer players a deeper gameplay experience on battlefields, so prepare yourselves and deploy your intelligence to occupy the next base! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d2e7a2da324e2fa2c7d2ee7e3deacaf2e6816aef.gif[/img]

As we know that siege plays an important role in the late game, our team has always been keeping an eye on feedback from you guys within our community about the siege mode. The rules of the new siege system are quite different from the old version and will pose a challenge to players regarding gameplay strategies. There will be all-new military structures for you to construct, including the ballista workshop to manufacture siege weapons. As players upgrade the workshop, those military structures on the siege map will be upgraded as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/1669045b90b9f3b7fcf2941a7f4f0a2d2a736f3b.gif[/img]

In addition, this update fixed a couple of issues that our English players are most concerned about, and more surprises will be revealed in the upcoming update announcement. 

As always, if you encounter any issues in-game, please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/xdindie]Discord server[/url]. We will be there listening to your advice and trying our best to offer support.

Stay tuned and see you next week!

notes.title: Update Log 11-30 (New Checkpoints, Bazaar Fix)
notes.content:
Update 0.8.1.3 for [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] is now live! In this update, we are continuing to patch up issues for the November update, most notably the Bazaar not correctly showing up for some players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/0a6f07d88574e96b8c1470a6a07140150875fad3.jpg[/img]

We also slipped in a small QoL improvement by adding checkpoints to all regions of the world map, you can set one of them as a rally point, which will respawn your army after a defeat, so you don’t have to run across the map to retry a certain encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/17c004e8d5eabb6b85ba07cca9caa7bc914049b9.jpg[/img]

There are also a few balance changes this update, you can read the full patch notes below. As usual, join our Discord or send us an email to indie@xd.com if you have further issues or feedback!

[url=https://discord.gg/xdindie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d9f505e53b3db86b20976be03ee6e2a440458716.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2020-11-30 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.1.3)[/h2]

[h3]New Addition[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added checkpoints to all major regions on the map. Your army will rally at the nearest checkpoint after being defeated.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana cost adjustment for Shaman's skill page, reduced power for some skills.
[*] Defense bonus for heavy armor troops increased to 12, up from 3.
[*] Reduced power of Nasir Ace Crossbowman.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bazaars now correctly spawn for some players.
[*] Berserker's Skull Bash now correctly gains bonuses from skills.
[*] You can now inspect enemies' army composition before going into battle.
[*] Fixed missing translations for certain UI interfaces.
[*] (Mod) Fixed an error in the custom trading interface when comparing items.
[*] (Mod) Custom item information interface now properly displays rich text.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Log 11-24 (Fire Dragon Promotion, Neutral Town Siege)
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Log 11-20 (Quest Tracking, Combat Adjustment)
notes.content:
The first major update of Sands of Salzaar’s next stage of development is now here. But before that, we have some other news to share with you: Sands of Salzaar won the Best Game Award at the 2020 IndiePlay Awards! We are honored by our players’ support and feedback, and will continue to improve the game during Early Access and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6ab2647052a09c1350118f30a8d510841611d04c.jpg[/img]

Back to today’s update! In case you missed it, you can read about our update plan and roadmap for the next few months [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1094520/view/2940248183373376053]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/e6e6ba399e402a1a75888dc37cbda1cb89242796.png[/img]

[h2]New Quest Tracking Feature[/h2]

In the November update, one of our biggest priorities is to address a very frequent feedback: the quests lack direction and are often too vague for their own good. To address this, we added a new quest guidance system. You can now either pinpoint a main quest objective on the map, or follow a compass to find your destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d112071928bccc8f9868d30ef8547298a3efb8d5.png[/img]

For players that wish to immerse themselves in the game world, there is an option for you as well. Tavern hostesses will have rumors for your mysterious quests, and the clues will expand over time, in case you need them for late steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b4718bd207587977e2834d099ab46f9a5d59b7aa.png[/img]

[h2]Combat and AI Improvements[/h2]

Another major addition we’ve included in this update is the first of the major changes to the combat system. New battle scenario maps are added for better visual variety in combat. Troop AI behavior in battle has also been adjusted, in particular to cavalry units and ranged units, which will now attempt to fight with melee weapons when necessary, instead of constantly trying to run away, much to the annoyance of players. Finally, there is a major rebalance of troops, especially at the higher tiers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/785459f6c5890ab12771c64c5e8d6b18aa275b91.gif[/img]

Some of the combat changes were part of work previously slated for later, but we’ve decided to bring them forward. These are things we are constantly working on, and we’d love to hear your feedback on the changes. In addition, we are focusing on single player mode features at this time, so the multiplayer map expansion previously planned for this update has been moved to a later date.

[h2]Expanded English Mod Support[/h2]

Last but not the least, to further support the English speaking modding scene, we’ve further expanded English tool support by localizing table headers of the reference excel files, and made them easier to access. A couple of untranslated modding tools are also localized. This is another field we are still in active iteration process, so let us know your modding experience as well.

Speaking of mods, some modders in our community are also working on localizing their award winning mods of the second modding event, you can take a look at the winners [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1094520/view/2940248183380486096]here[/url].

If you encounter any issue in-game, contact us through indie@xd.com, or join us on Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/xdindie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/d9f505e53b3db86b20976be03ee6e2a440458716.png[/img][/url]

The full patch notes are as below.

[h3]2020-11-20 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.1.1)[/h3]

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Brand new quest guidance system, with map coordinates and compass options.
[*] You can now ask for rumors at taverns for certain active quests. Options for the rumors will expand and change over time.
[*] 12 new battleground maps, which will spawn randomly depending on army composition and related environment.
[*] New combat moveset for sword, dagger, spear and staff.
[*] New animation set for dragons.
[*] AI and animation improvements for cavalry units.
[*] Added English headers for modding resource excel files and rearranged configuration tables.
[*] Teammate position indicator widget added to multiplayer mod.
[*] You can now set password for your multiplayer session.
[*] Added custom item slot feature to the mod editor. You can custom item slot and type name of any number, define slot exclusivity logic like differentiating between one and two handed weapons and more. Refer to GUI and LUA reference mod for more information.
[*] Added trade GUI reset function to the mod editor.[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Some persistent NPCs (Mysterious Witch and Haberdasher, for example) now show up in the town roster.
[*] Adjusted ranged unit AI and their movement behavior. Certain ranged troops will also attempt to fight with melee weapons when necessary.
[*] Removed the time limit of Bazaar.
[*] Adjusted combat roll animation.
[*] Updated Beastmaster’s dragon form model.
[*] Tasha, Threnody and Omar are now automatically assigned “in the wild” status once certain side quests are completed. You no longer need to use Legacy to bring them into the game.
[*] Significant troop stats and skill revamp. Certain high tier troops have also been redesigned, this include Dakn Elder, Dakn Priestess, Nasir Crossbowman, Nasir Healer and more.
[*] Adjusted the following skills: Wild Wolf Bite (Beastmaster), Beast Stampede (Beastmaster), Slam (Beastmaster), Lunging Chop (Berserker), Primal Dance (Berserker), Aftershock (Sentinel).
[*] Cooldown and mana cost adjustment for some skills.
[*] Most dungeon with chest rewards now change their battleground map accordingly.
[*] Added missing illustrations for certain quest NPCs.
[*] The multiplayer lobby now shows all available and in-progress multiplayer sessions. Players will also be returned to the session itself instead of the main menu after finishing or failing a multiplayer game.
[*] All mod configuration table files are now arranged in two languages, this includes file names and column titles.
[*] All open source configuration tables can now be found in "Example_ExcelReference" folder under game installation path. Mod developers no longer need to extract them from open source mods.[/list]

notes.title: The Second Modding Event: Awesome Mod Spotlights
notes.content:
Dear desert travelers,

After sifting through a variety of high-quality entries for [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i]’s Second Modding Event, we are excited to reveal today the list of cool mods selected by our official team! Before announcing the results, we’d like to thank all the participants. It was such a pleasure to explore everyone’s creations! 

Compared to the First Modding Event in May, the second comp has inundated us with more diversity, more professional mods with higher technical requirements, more multiplayer maps, and even massive story overhauls that totally remake the game with all-new gameplay and storylines. Such progress not only comes from the constant technical updates on modding toolsets, but also owes a great deal to our passionate modders always dedicated to improving modding skills to realize the full potential of our humble indie.

So, without further ado, here comes the complete list of selected mods:

[u][h3]The Excellence Prize:[/h3][/u]
[b]乌坦城之变 (The Wu Tan City Uprising)[/b]
Mod Author: skyswordkill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/143835d894ae924b2e0a16e7aa9e9561f230471b.png[/img]

The whole multiplayer map based on the IP of the popular Chinese fiction [i]Battle Through the Heavens [/i]is remade with an all-new GUI, leaving a strong first impression on players. The re-designed skill system consists of passive and active abilities to be ranked up. The gameplay is more of a stats-based RPG, with huge potential in future updates.

[b]空界之传v2.0版 (Hollow Chronicles 2.0)[/b]
Mod Author: KK大魔王Acrab

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6a928d91afb7af5a30912030477b0ab6b2d180ce.jpg[/img]

Based on the Japanese novel series [i]Sword Art Online[/i], this mod includes two fictional characters with exclusive plots and quests, adds several new maps, and introduces skills like crafting equipment and items. The mod overall is very polished with frequent updates. Some newly-added dungeons are also well-designed.

[u][h3]The Merit Prize:[/h3][/u]
[b]墨家传人正式版 (The Descendants of Mo)[/b]
Mod Author: M3小蘑菇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/5b6f97fd08b08a87cfaf55222ab8ac6d19cc5b33.png[/img]

If you like game storytelling and martial arts, this is the mod you can’t miss. A new character The Descendants of Mo is added and the original storylines about Mohism will soon get you immersed in the game. We really look forward to seeing the ending of the story!

[b]少女与弯刀 (Femme Salzaar)[/b]
Mod Author: HA会长

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/38f5d1d1fc373f69b025f9007c8e3ee962a366f0.png[/img]

This campaign mod is the base mod for “The Weaker Sex”. These two mods feature an original female character, new female NPCs and a variety of female combat arms. The recent update remade characters’ portraits and added a slew of new storylines. Strongly recommended.

[b]动态人物互动与势力交互大修 (Dynamic Character and Faction Interactions)[/b]
Mod Author: skyswordkill & 勃兰登堡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/eb4333750212a9364f34829615f3e25ef27991f0.png[/img]

This mod expands the base game’s Favor system and interactions with NPCs and factions. Now you can have chit chat, practice fighting with other fellow characters, make confessions of love to your crush, trade cities with other factions, and even beg for goods.

[b]数码宝贝 (Digimon)[/b]
Mod Author: 宇文kong

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/35b3357935729de4c72d78ee35a19b5afe3c770d.png[/img]

This mod adds a variety of Digimons as combat arms in-game which can be upgraded with different progression routes. The Digimon library is comprehensive with unique signature skills , and the models are so exquisitely-designed that sometimes cause frame drops in the troop upgrade interface. 

[h3][u]The Creativity Prize:[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Horde and Tank
[*] Grant Instant death to your enemies-Kara No Kyoukai -The mystic eyes of death perception
[*] 情比金坚3.0 (Heart of Gold)
[*] “星”世界 (Starworld)
[*] 弯刀塔防肉搏 (Melee Tower Defense)
[*] 命运传承 (Fated Legacy)
[/list]
[h3][u]The Participation Prize:[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] 神兽坐骑大礼包 (Bizarre Mounts)
[*] Summon Skills and 3 Passive Skills
[*] 双花之禧 (The Wedding of Roses)
[*] 更有用的商品 (More Useful Trade Goods)
[*] 新角色：剑侠 (New Character: Sword Master)
[*] 月饼【商人卖】(Mooncake)
[*] 北斗导航寻人系统 (Global NPC Positioning System)
[*] 部落暖暖  (The Wardrobe)
[*] 自动翻译器 (Auto Translator)
[*] 装备大师与炼器之心 (Craftmaster and The Heart of Craft)
[*] 潘多拉魔盒 (Pandora’s Box)
[*] 告别抽卡 (Troops, on Demand)
[*] 技能魔改篇 (Skill Enhancement)
[*] 每日获取玉石 (Daily Jades)
[*] 我有一个菜园 (My Own Garden)
[*] 一些功能 (Misc Features)
[*] 有我就够了 (All You Need)
[*] 旅行药剂商人 (Travelling Potion Vendor)
[*] 灵剑角色MOD (Spectral Blade)
[*] 渣男语录~约会表白羞羞交互mod (Dating and Confession)
[/list]
Congrats again to all the authors who made these awesome mods above! You guys will receive our prizes in the following weeks. If you haven’t gotten in touch with us yet, no worries, we will contact you on Steam, or you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/q5r9PEy]Discord[/url] or email us (indie@xindong.com) so that we can send you the prize.

We are glad to see there are English mods on the list. Given some coding issues in English modding toolsets, it is quite difficult for our English modders to get their creative juices flowing this time. To fix these problems, we are currently working on localizing all the Excels containing Chinese item IDs for modding. Besides, we will[b] optimize English modding support in the next major update[/b], which you can read about in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1094520/announcements/detail/2940248183373376054]roadmap update blog[/url], and [b]more popular Workshop mods including the prize-winning mods in this comp will be localized into English[/b] for our English players to enjoy a variety of custom gaming experiences.

For[i] Sands of Salzaar[/i], mod not only substantially expands the original gaming experience with innovative custom content, but also helps us find out what players would like to see and change in this game. Therefore, in addition to improving modding support in future updates, we will continue to add new content to the base game, rebalance and optimize in-game systems in accordance with feedback from our Community. The desert world will keep evolving. Stay tuned for more!

Sincerely,
[i]Sands of Salzaar[/i]’s Team

notes.title: Sands of Salzaar Roadmap Update: What's Next
notes.content:
After the launch of Sands of Salzaar's latest major update “Battle of the Black Sun” which brought English localization and a slew of new content, now we are ready to reveal what’s coming up next in the development of Sands of Salzaar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/df08a77de1fb59bf1215b070cf72974a1da282e0.png[/img]

[h1]November 2020: Quest Improvements and Additions to Multiplayer[/h1]

The current iteration of multiplayer in Sands of Salzaar is just a framework of what is possible, and for the next major update we want to address the issues discovered during this period and further polish the current content. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/5e1872bf488b72137c73788798ececa5705848e8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Update highlights[/h3]

[list]
[*] New additions to the multiplayer framework and “Battle of the Black Sun” map[/list]
This includes refinements for the co-op map, and various multiplayer specific item/gear changes.
[list]
[*] Continuous development of mod tools and expanded support for English language mod tools[/list]
There will undoubtedly be increased demands on mod tool features and stability after the English launch and the multiplayer feature, this is something crucial for talented mod makers to unleash their creativity. We are also looking to optimize the support for English mod makers so no matter what language you choose to play in, you could always share the freedom of modding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/56c146233df959390724000e435aea4b62500398.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Quest system improvements[/list]
We also want to address some of the most emergent pain points like the quest system and further refine quest content.
[list]
[*] Additional mod developer support for multiplayer
[*] More battleground map variations in singleplayer[/list]
We are targeting a 1-2 month development time for this update, the features listed above are more urgent, with additional challenges from the multiplayer.

[h1]January 2021: Siege Battle Improvements and New Class[/h1]

One of the most frequent feedbacks we received is the lack of variety in siege battles, especially during endgame and repeated sieges. More siege command options, and unit pathing are also we are specifically working on to fix and improve.

[h3]Update highlights[/h3]

[list]
[*] Siege battle improvements[/list]
The current siege battle design is not interesting enough, the lack of AI challenge makes endgame a bit on the tedious side of things. A revamp to siege battles would significantly increase the quality of battle experience throughout the game.
[list]
[*] A new starting class[/list]
I mean, who doesn’t like new playable characters? Although we’d love to keep the details on this in wraps for now. Plus, we are also making improvements to other classes and tuning the overall balance.
[list]
[*] PvP multiplayer map sample.[/list]
After the previous additions to the multiplayer framework and Battle of the Black Sun co-op map, we are planning to add a simple competitive multiplayer map as a sample.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/4419079612147ba88082a2449a1235988ee799be.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Existing classes optimizations
[*] Existing troop balancing
[*] Troop AI improvements[/list]
[h1]April 2021: Better Character Interactions, New Side Quests and Controller Support[/h1]

For this kind of open world game, nuances in character interaction is a very interesting aspect. To achieve what we want from the system, a few major changes must be made, including a redesign of favor/reputation system, more character side stories and more variety in NPC actions.

[h3]Update highlights[/h3]

[list]
[*] Nuanced character relationships[/list]
We envision Sands of Salzaar to be leaning towards the RPG side of a game, and we want it to feel like a proper one. The depth, characteristics, and the resulting possibilities in their interactions are what make every playthrough unique and interesting, and we want the players to have the desire to understand the world, the people and their backstories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3abc4671278d18f2a39fefc05fb66f871eac24c2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] More faction activities[/list]
Factions within the story will become more active in their trading, plundering and under table dealings. They will be much smarter when it comes to decisions, which leads to many more uncertainties and possibilities. You might want to change how you approach that certain Sultan a little, or a lot.
[list]
[*] More character side stories
[*] Controller support[/list]
This is a very important feature for us, and is something necessary for Sands of Salzaar to expand to other platforms like the Nintendo Switch. It’s relatively simple to support controllers for combat, but a total UI overhaul is necessary for full controller support, so this is something we are doing a bit later into development.

[h1]Final Words[/h1]

That’s what we have today for the next chapter in the world of Sands of Salzaar. We will also continue to update the game, fixing bugs and adding key features during this stage of development.

We are truly humbled by the tremendous amount of support since our last major release, and all the constructive feedback is incredibly valuable for us to determine what to do next for the game. We hope you like our showings here, and see you in the desert!

notes.title: Update Log 10-15 (Unstuck feature, Durability Improvement)
notes.content:
Early Access Update 0.8.0.7 for [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] is now live. We are taking measures to resolve some of the deeper gameplay related issues that impact your experience in this update. 

You can now unstuck your character with the new feature in game settings. Opening the inventory screen in combat now pauses the game, so you can comfortably use recovery items or rearrange skills. 

Further on the quality of life front, you no longer lose durability for the entire party’s items even if only a couple characters entered a dungeon, levitating some of the durability woes. Messages from other factions also no longer interrupt your more urgent actions such as preparing a siege.

We are also looking at solutions to address the following issues in future updates:
[list]
[*] Add new tools to streamline gear repairs.
[*] Fix quest item progress logic so you don't need to reobtain quest items you already have in your inventory.[/list]

Last but definitely not the least, expect a glimpse of what’s on the horizon for [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] soon!

For complete update notes, read further down below. In the meantime, check out our known issue list [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1094520/discussions/0/2842291719990426980/]here[/url] and hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]Discord server[/url] for more discussion and feedback.

[url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/863b66199331a41ef2fed14115f65d12754ba716.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a81a6b388864cf1c5dfae5a1cd0fb4b5511999de.jpg[/img]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Diplomatic events like declaration of war or gesture of peace no longer prompt dialogue boxes that interrupt siege preparation. Players now need to address those events in the Message interface (bottom left in the world map) within a certain amount of time.
[*] Slightly reduced the power of Silver Warrior's skills.
[*] Certain dialogues now properly address characters based on their gender.
[*] Opening item and skill interface during battle in non-multiplayer modes now pauses the game.
[*] Removed reward selection dialogue from prestige levelups.[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing messenger quests to sometimes display incorrect locations.
[*] Ifrit Archer can can now be upgraded to Ifrit Flamespitter.
[*] Fixed a geometry issue in Umbra Cliffs.
[*] Fixed an item description display issue caused by item customization interface in multiplayer.
[*] The legacy shop now properly displays all items under non 16:9 resolutions.
[*] Modded custom factions that do not have a designated color no longer cause all cities to lose their faction color.
[*] Battles that only require certain characters no longer incorrectly deduct item durability from all party members.
[*] Fixed an issue causing certain quests to not update their quest item obtain progress.
[*] On difficulty level 1 and higher, troop upgrade tree now displays the correct troop level required for the upgrade.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/a4ce3f624f44b124b7a066fd187227997693180c.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Our Special Modding Event #2 is open!
notes.content:
Dear desert travelers,

Since the launch of the English localization edition, we’ve been receiving lots of attention, kind support, and feedback from our players worldwide, among which we notice that many of you are asking about the English mod support.

Currently, [b]the English Mod Editor is still under testing but fully open to our modders[/b]. Our devs are working on fine-tuning English modding tools and updating the mod developer manual. In the meantime, we hope to encourage our players to take a shot at creating some English mods, which will help the devs better troubleshoot potential modding problems as well as bring new energy to our global modding community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/5621963116d4dcb2e16641a07e313fc91bfc917b.png[/img]

[h2]Special Modding Event #2[/h2]
During the first Sands of Salzaar Modding Event in May, our incredible modders fully unleashed their power of creativity and imagination, developing a variety of inspiring mods. This time, we decided to [b]open the second Special Modding Event to players worldwide[/b], encouraging our English players to get started on mod development as well. Here are the general event rules:
[list]
[*] The Modding Event is open from [b]Sept. 26th to Oct. 18th[/b] to players worldwide.
[*] All Event mods need to be uploaded to Steam Workshop.
[*] For English mods, modders need to tag their Event mods with “[b][Mod Event][/b]” at the beginning of their mod names, e.g. “[Mod Event] Medieval map”.
[*] We will select some best mods among the entries and offer their modders special prizes, including one First Prize worth $1100, two Second Prize worth $740 each, three Third Prize worth $370 each, and 10 Participation Prize worth $70 each.
[/list]
To help English modders understand how to use the Mod Editor, the devs have prepared a full documentation of English mod development in the [url=https://blywd.hanjiasongshu.com/index.php?title=MODDeveloperManual&uselang=en]official wiki[/url] and will keep updating the manual with instructional videos in the future. If you encounter any problems when creating English mods, please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]Discord[/url] and our team will be there ready to answer any questions and help solve your modding issues.

[h2]Pick Localized Mods in Workshop [/h2]
There are already hundreds of mods available in Steam Workshop, featuring custom maps, new characters, themes, perks and more. To provide English players with a more diverse gaming experience, some of our modders have uploaded their localized mods to Workshop. If you wanna subscribe to these mods, go to the Workshop in-game and select “English Localized Mods” in the drop-down menu at the upper-left corner of the screen to browse the list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/79d71f5f97f9e570e16452bdb5ef24fa8e732ca8.png[/img]

Please note that these mods may contain some untranslated parts and bugs, but the modders in our community are willing to listen to your feedback and optimize their work. There will be more translated mods coming in the future. If you want to see your favorite mod or a particular type of mods to be localized, leave your comments below or in our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update Log 9-25 (Difficulty, Collision Detection, and More Bugfixes)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Since [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i]’s latest content update that brought the game to English players, we have been receiving countless great feedback and kind words. Everyone on the dev team is thrilled to deliver the game to a new audience, and we thank you for all the support! 

We are actively going through all the feedback and bug reports to address the issues as soon as possible with daily updates. Yesterday we released patch 0.8.0.2 to fix some urgent issues like ultrawide users not being able to start a new game and missing final boss model. Today we will be releasing another update, you can read the patch notes below.

As always, if you encounter any issue, please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]Discord server[/url] and let us know, this is the fastest way to get feedback directly to us, so we highly encourage you to do so!

[url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/863b66199331a41ef2fed14115f65d12754ba716.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]2020-09-25 Codename: Battle of the Black Sun (0.8.0.3)[/b][/h3]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] A small number of players may encounter issues when playing the in-game cinematics, causing crashes at game start or the ending cinematic. We've re-encoded the cinematics and added a detection mechanism. If you encounter this issue, please try again, the game will automatically detect the previous error and offer a skip option to avoid this.
[*] You can now properly select higher difficulty after completing the main story once.
[*] Non-host players can properly spawn enemies after interacting with certain mechanics in multiplayer.
[*] Made an attempt to address AI enemy units moving out of bounds in battle, causing players to not be able to defeat them.
[*] Certain abilities now properly break invisibility after use.
[*] Fixed an issue causing repaired items to still show as broken.
[*] Random quests that require defeating certain heroes can now be properly completed.
[*] Some open world map collision fixes.
[*] Various translation and text fixes.
[*] You can now talk to the female Ifrit to skip being stuck in the wrong map for the quest "Rivers and Goddesses".
[*] Fixed a map collision issue around the Jade Stone chest in one of the Ifrit camps.
[*] Fixed an issue causing players to trigger the battle with Olum twice if clicked too quickly.
[*] Fixed an issue causing certain swappable abilities to not function properly when changing maps in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed some UI issues caused by certain buffs in multiplayer.
[*] You can now properly continue the conversation if you choose to keep Ox's secret in Jihan's quest.
[*] The quest log will now correctly reset after Beastmaster/Shaman completes the story quest of Husnu.[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a ritual marking to the entrance of Knight-Errant's main story dungeon.
[*] Deserters now spawn in smaller areas for deserter hunt quests.
[*] Added items scattered on the map for "Rivers and Goddesses" level.
[*] Dyed Shawl and Mastigure Knight Emblem now have a durability of 50.
[*] Geometry and collision fixes for multiplayer map B.
[*] Reduced cast time for Swordcraft: Arc Swing, Aftershock, Archery: Barrage, Archery: Cloudpierce, Archery: Icy Barrage, Archery: Fireblast, Archery: Firehail and Archery: Icehail.
[*] Adjusted attack range for Duress, Swordcraft: Arc Swing, Aftershock and Ancient Machina: Boomerang.
[*] Redesigned Swordcraft: Flash.
[*] Increased attack speed for these weapons in multiplayer: Fireball Wand, Frost Wand, Radiant Wand, Ultimate Staff, Ultimate Wand, Death Wand and Bone Staff.
[*] Reduced cast time for these skills in multiplayer: Bubble Trouble and Earth's Refuge.[/list]
[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Pressing the map hotkey in battle now closes the map.
[*] Added a more distinctive indicator for the player character in battle maps.[/list]

notes.title: The English Language Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
Since the Early Access launch, we have been constantly adding new features, new content and all kinds of fixes to [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] to improve the player experience. Today, the newest chapter in the desert saga begins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/0226471c93905178a87a246c022c839cf7634010.png[/img]
The Battle of the Black Sun Update launches on Steam at 9am PST, September 22nd, bringing the highly anticipated[b] English localization [/b]to the game, along with a wide range of new content, optimizations, and a [b]best-ever discount of 40%[/b] until Oct. 6! 

We have also released the original soundtrack for our game, available below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416310/Sands_of_Salzaar_Soundtrack/

You can join the discussion of [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/SSalzaar]Twitter[/url], and hang out with like-minded players in our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]official Discord server[/url].

[h2]Update Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Now in English![/h3]
[i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] is now officially out in English! Over 500 thousand words worth of content have been fully translated into English for players from all over the world to enjoy! 

[h3]The Desert Legend continues[/h3]
[b]Main Story[/b]
The main story of [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] receives significant additions in this update, with 60 thousand words of new content that further progresses and fleshes out the story. The secrets behind Ilayda and The Ifrit will be there for you to discover...

The five factions now have more significant roles to play. New battle additions also further tie up the gameplay element with the narrative. 

[b]The Ifrit’s Domain[/b]
Ifrit Void Master returns to his crusade against humanity with his eight henchmen and ten fortresses. The barrier imposed by the River Goddess eons ago has been broken, revealing the Ifrit Domain and connecting it to the desert. 

Will you continue to uphold your guard for humanity, or will you create a new world order with The Ifrit?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/2638c0be792c5aa4c25edaaab6b3c34c08640d83.png[/img]
[b]New Side Quests[/b]
Side quests involving Olum and Book of Fire are added. New mysteries are also unearthed alongside The Ifrit’s conspiracies, waiting for the most steely-eyed adventurers to discover and challenge. Beware, your choice might make them unnecessarily complicated…

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
In this update, we also introduced multiplayer for the first time to[i] Sands of Salzaar[/i]. We provided an official campaign called “Battle of the Black Sun” as a demonstration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b4d9a0b24a1c7b0e3fd8c51d195300848d38ef3c.jpg[/img]
In Battle of the Black Sun, you can play alongside up to 3 other players (4 total), select from 10 characters with 5 different archetypes to begin an adventure. Gain levels and skill points by completing combat challenges, learn increasingly powerful skills, loot and purchase gear with different powers, explore the world and unearth mysteries with your friends.

[b]The Multiplayer Arena feature is highly experimental[/b], the current iteration is meant to be an example for MOD developers, showcasing the possibilities. There will be some issues including crashes and instabilities. We will be constantly monitoring how this feature performs, making changes and adding new content to fully flesh out this experience.

This feature is also [b]fully MOD compatible[/b]. MOD creators can design their own characters, skills, items and level designs, upload them to the Steam Workshop to share them with the community.

[h3]English MOD support[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/c8e550d4df159831e3cf68d9598b438bdc9d59d0.png[/img]
Our commitment to the modding community also expands to the global audience with the English update. The in-game MOD editor is fully translated, and we have localized our full MOD development documentation which you can check out [url=https://blywd.hanjiasongshu.com/index.php?title=MODDeveloperManual&uselang=en]here[/url]. 

The ability to create multi-language MODs is also added in this update, this feature is currently still under development, we will continue to improve the tools for modders around the world to fully unleash their creative muscle.

A number of popular MODs have been translated into English, so you will be able to enhance your experience from the get go.

[h3]And Much More...[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6ad3d33d0389e99b46d514cc523b5cfb3e949f63.jpg[/img]
For a detailed rundown of additions and changes in this update, read out full release note below:

[h3][i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] Early Access Patch 0.8.0.1 (Codename: Battle of the Black Sun)[/h3]
[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] is now in English!
[*] Added an experimental Multiplayer Arena mode, with an official multiplayer map: Battle of the Black Sun, which supports a maximum of 4 players. 
[*] In this official co-op map, there are 10 characters with 5 archetypes, 88 learnable skills, and 100+ items in the shop. We will keep optimizing the map and add new content to the mode.
[*] Added new storylines worth about 60k words, which replaces the original storyline (you can still use the old saves to play old storylines).
[*] Several main story boss fights and some small-scale systems.
[*] Several sidequests that may spawn as the main storylines unfold.
[*] Added a new side quest related to Book of Fire, with a new skill page and boss fight.
[*] New map: Ifrit Domain, and new Ifrit faction which will be revealed as you continue your main story progression.
[*] Added several new random quests.
[*] Several new heroes have been added to factions, starting as their Sultans.
[*] Secondary outposts have been redesigned, they can now station troops, can be occupied, and can build a limited amount of buildings.
[*] Strategic AI logic has been rewritten. Now AI factions will spontaneously form army groups for offensives and can intelligently select targets to lay siege upon.
[*] Redesigned underlying logic of diplomatic strategies. Al factions can now form alliances and build relationships.
[*] Added a series of staff weapons that scatter around the desert map.
[*] Added some new character models and illustrations.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] A balance pass on soldier recruitment fees.
[*] Some specialties can no longer be given as gifts.
[*] Rebalanced loot from certain monsters and dungeons.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where specialties could not respawn in some traveling merchants’ inventories.
[*] Fixed an issue where Bounty Hunters are not able to complete their main storyline dungeon.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevents Sultan from upgrading the Jade Mine.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPC could not obtain mounts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/edd8fee21de961e68442ba4b1d987bd68914e1bc.jpg[/img]
[h2]Final Words[/h2]
This update is a very important one for [i]Sands of Salzaar[/i] as it opens up the game to a brand new audience. We hope you enjoy our additions and features, and thank you very much for the continuous support. 

We would also like to shoutout our passionate beta testers on our [url=https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy]official Discord server[/url] who helped us polish and improve the update in the past several weeks: Thank you, from the deepest of our hearts. 

That’s all from us today, we’ll see you in the desert!

notes.title: English localization update coming soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TfH4B897pt8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey all,

We are very excited to announce that our English language launch date is confirmed! You will be able to play the English version on [b]September 22[/b], alongside a rich variety of new content! 

Since the Early Access launch on Jan. 3 this year, our game has seen a series of major updates adding new characters, crossover events, side quests and modding functions, while this time's update will be even more unprecedented:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/48fd49f83e2dc145395dbaa0b9cc9edc47065d88.png[/img]

[b][u]RICH NARRATIVE[/u][/b]
The upcoming English version will feature a full translation of nearly [b]500,000 words[/b], together with new story content including[b] 30 new quests[/b]. The game tells a desert epic tale in the Orient where the Old Empire has fallen amid the Battle of the Black Sun, leaving five warring tribes fighting over territories and treasures, while greater disasters are awaiting…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3f2ba8bf3cbce6c3c8b12bd2fa679b33b8a157da.gif[/img]

[b][u]OPEN DESERT WORLD [/u][/b]
Alongside the main storyline, you roam around the huge map and explore six vast regions of distinct landscapes, you can plot your own rise from a nobody to a powerful warlord, a knight-errant, a notorious bandit, or a shrewd merchant...In our English update, multiple in-game values will be adjusted to [b]optimize the mid/late open-world gaming experience[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/527f938d085bb147a1c108b37c159f9364ea5fcc.gif[/img]

[b][u]BATTLE & STRATEGY[/u][/b]
Sands of Salzaar features both large-scale wars and skirmishes. In top-down real-time combat, you fight hostile forces, besiege their bases, explore perilous dungeons for loots and hunt wild beasts. You can recruit and upgrade your basic combat arms into elite troops, customize your hero’s skill trees, and deploy your armies to slay the foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/dd0fd987fe7b3bee8a2ac03c18da200cf63acd1b.gif[/img]

[b][u]HIGH REPLAYABILITY[/u][/b]
With each playthrough, you become stronger and discover different questlines, using Legacy points to unlock bonus characters, abilities, and rare items. Every time you play, a new adventure unfolds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/6d8b84def30aee72c9440676f9261ea1697100d2.gif[/img]

[b][u]FULL MODDING SUPPORT[/u][/b]
Our game includes full mod support via Steam Workshop, with hundreds of mods adding a variety of in-game perks, new characters, and custom maps. The mod editor will soon [b]support multiplayer as well with official example maps[/b] allowing you to embark on the battlefield with your pals. 

Also, our [b]English beta test[/b] is now underway. Don’t miss out. Come join us on our Discord (https://discord.gg/q5r9PEy) to apply for the playtest!

Cheers,
Sand of Salzaar’s team

notes.title: The recent progress on English localization and our Discord
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/93771acfaeef02f92835527f2c118f4623dc0496.jpg[/img]
[b]Hey guys,[/b]

Steam Summer Sale is approaching. [b]Sand’s of Salzzar will be having a 20% discount from June 25 at 10:00 am PDT to July 9 at 10:00 am PDT.[/b] Also, in this post, I’d like to share our recent progress on the localization project and our upcoming Discord channel.

[h3][b]English Localization:[/b][/h3]
We are still working on our localization project. The current total translation amount is about 324,000 Chinese words including intricate storyline, rare item and skill names as well as various exotic toponyms. Additionally, a 60,000-word new storyline will be added to the English version later. As our devs are continuously adding new content to the original game, our translation amount is also ever-growing.

Such a huge translation amount poses a real challenge to an indie game studio like us. We need to allocate enough time and manpower to localize the game with the goal of offering a compelling gaming experience as same as the original version to English players. Therefore, it takes months for us to finish the project. 

In the past few months, when we constantly got questions from you guys about the English launch date, we had mixed feelings about that: we were really grateful for all your interest in our game, while we also felt quite sorry to keep you waiting. However, you won’t be waiting long from now. We will dedicate ourselves to bringing out a high-quality localized version expected to launch around this summer.

[h3][b]Upcoming Discord Channel:[/b][/h3]
Another news is that we are currently preparing for our official Discord server! Please follow the game on our Steam store page and add to your wishlist to get notified in the first place when the Discord server is open. 

On the Discord channel for Sands of Salzaar, we will constantly provide you guys with exciting game news and fresh updates. Also, when the English translation is done, we will select a bunch of players on our Discord channel for the beta test of the English version. 

Therefore, you will have the chance to obtain a free key, test the localized version in advance, share your gameplay experience with other English players, and report any potential issues directly to our team on Discord to get prompt feedback and help us refine the game!

That’s all for the update! As the localization project progresses, we will reveal more details about our English version, so please stay tuned and prepare for your fantastical journey into the desert!

[b]Sincerely,
Sands of Salzaar’s team[/b]

notes.title: The first Workshop MOD Event! & Updates in early May！
notes.content:

notes.title: Sands of Salzaar Early Access March Update (NPC story, custom game)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've added personal story missions for Xihenaya, Helianqianbai, Yeya, and Tikexin. After meeting the requirements, you will be able to start their storylines. At the same time, we have added a custom game mode that players will be able to adjust the difficulty, special properties, and more. Experience a totally different adventure.  We've also brought new models, illustrations, merchants, custom battle mode, custom map icons! And of course, the Mod editor gets new features, too. The tutorials of the new functions are all added to our Mod editor tutorial videos and Wiki. 

Thank you for all your support! We'll keep creating fun and interesting new content! If you have encountered any issue in the game, please feel free to send an email to indie@xindong.com.

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
- Added the personal missions of Helian Qianbai, Ye Ya, Tixon, and Xeonawa. The mission will be unlocked only after the character's friendliness level, teammate level, and global reputation have reached to a certain point.

- There will be a notification on your teammate who has persenal mission in the team interface.

- Added the real mode game option. Turning on this option and player will not be able to  recruit powerful magical creatures such as dragons, demons, angels, and phoenixes in the game. Meanwhile, players can recruit soldiers in the city settlements with a trade license, the upgrade experience and cost of all the soldiers will be reduced by 30%; the probability of death is increased by 30%.

- Added game content configuration system. Through table configuration, some custom shaping fields in the game can be operated during the beginning and halfway of the game, to set the game content, AI difficulty, feature switches, etc., allowing players to customize content for his own game.

- Added a custom battle mode. In this mode, players can choose any unit or hero who has joined the protagonist team in the game to engage in a battle.

- Added custom map markers. Players can right-click on the large map and choose to create a custom map marker information on an explored map location, and edit or delete the marker.

- Added character models of Gallo of the West River, Tixon, Ann the Red Sand, The Little Yellow Dog.

- Optimized the loading speed of the loading interface after entering the game

- When the AI ​​character updates the equipment, there will be probability that the updated equipment better than the current one according to the strength of the AI.

- Removed the leather and linen from some merchants goods, and enriched the merchants' goods.

-Added illustrations of mount merchant and pet merchant.

-Changed the default model of Shadow Assassin.

-Changed the default face model of Wild Soul.

- -Adjusted the composition and drop of soldiers of Wildfire.

- The probability of recruiting "farmers" in villages is now greatly reduced.

- Now in the backpack and store interface, left-clicking an item can lock the details of the item, so when the item information description is too long, you can drag to display all the information content.

- Some new available configuration fields have been added to the map information field of the map. (For details, please refer to the editing instructions on the WIKI page)

- The character standing illustration information can now display the preform in the format of "prefab: [Path]" as the character standing illustration, which can support the production of dynamic character standing illustration through plug-ins such as Spine. (An example MOD project or tutorial will be released later)

- Now the roles and units such as farmers and caravans have been moved from the code to the configuration table. Mod authors can modify this information through the corresponding configuration table.

[h3]Bug fixing[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where mainline missions could not be performed after starving in the initial scene.

- Fixed the problem that in the module development interface, after entering the project settings interface and saving the project, the initial scene and the data field in the script story mode will always be reset to "0", which prevents the game from not entering after the build.

- Fixed an issue in the module development interface where errors would occur after building other modules in the script story mode.

notes.title: The Update Plan About “the New Game+” and “the Inheritance Point”
notes.content:
Recently, we’ve received some complains about “the Inheritance Point” and “the forced New Game+”, we are still collecting feedbacks or suggestions from the whole community.

The purpose of the design of[b] "Players couldnn't gain any Point after 6 months"[/b] was to encourage trying different classes or professions. However, the actual “Inheritance Point” is too difficult to get, this part is not well experienced by many players.  and it had been labled as ”the forced replay”. We’ve already realized the issue. notes.title: Sands of Salzaar Early Access Update Plan & Content
notes.content:
[b]Our current update plan after launch of Early Access is as follows:[/b]

1. Continue updating our Mod Editor to include documentation, tools, tutorial videos, a community for developers, and more.

2. Add voiceovers and sound effects to a large number of characters. Add more models for NPCs, as well as side stories for certain factions of NPCs.

3. Add new playable characters with their own complete storylines.

4. Add more crossovers between our other title, Hanjia Jianghu, including a full expansion pack with characters from the game.

5. Add custom combat features which will allow players to adjust battle variables.

6. In the Code: Princess Coral update, we will add more complete building features and more types of buildings. In addition, we will add combat formations which players must master and command in order to defeat large hordes of enemies. New hidden locations and dungeons with their own side stories will be introduced as well. Lastly, more diversity will be added to regions on the world map which will continue to be updated in future versions.

7. In the Code: Battle of the Blood Moon update, we will be adding a more refined crafting system complete with recipes. A city siege system will also be introduced with optimized siege weapons, defensive towers, and other elements of siege warfare. Sands of Salzaar and content created through our Mod Editor will also begin supporting online combat in this update.

8. In the Code: Sirocco Valley update, we will be adding an additional solo adventure mode in which players explore the Imperial Tomb. A multilingual support framework will also be added to Sands of Salzaar, with Chinese and Japanese as our officially supported languages.

Our current Early Access plan is as described above. Updates planned further in the future will be announced directly in the community. Thanks for your support!

[b]No English support at launch

The English localization of Sands of Salzaar is still in progress. We apologize for not supporting English at the beginning of Early Access, and are grateful for your understanding! English support is one of our top priorities, and we aim to add it to the game ASAP. [/b]

- Please head over to the system setting of your windows system and search for Time&Date. Turn off the time zone auto-update function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/b3de1e1020e4de679df5bb88bfbbba2e9d097adf.png[/img]

- Then select a random time zone below in the time zone menu.

[u]2. Getting stuck in the steam library after pressing the [play] button[/u]

- If you encountered this issue, please try to close your anti-virus software first.
- If you are using Windows 10 system, please find the "UnityCrashHandler64" file in the game folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/3e679eae1593044c7496356a8968b9398c541bf5.png[/img]

- Right-click and go to "property", click on "Safety", and then click "edit"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/95223142804816979b872f06ee019addd7af2609.png[/img]

- Make sure the refuse option is checked. Then check "refuse" to "edit", "load and execute", "load", "overwrite" options.
- If you are not sure which user you've logged in with, just simply refuse all user access.

[u]3. Crash when selecting "New Game"[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/ecdf9eee7c01f080edb12ec493968f31e56c3530.png[/img]

- After reaching the main menu, activate the "Skip the intro" mod in the Mod menu.

If the solutions above could not solve the issue you encountered, or there is some other issue you have encountered in-game. Please feel free to send us an email via indie@xindong.com. We are working on a fix right now and will release a patch as soon as we can. We are so sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Early Access on Jan 3rd 2020! Loads of new features incoming!
notes.content:
[u][i]The English version is still in development! English localization will [b]NOT[/b] be included in the first early access version. We will release the English version as soon as we can when it is in a good place! Click the wishlist button if you’re interested![/i][/u]

Hello, gamers! Recently, we’ve invited some players to test out our game! Although the close test version didn’t fully reflect our vision, we have still received a great amount of support and raised lots of conversations on streams and forums. We could not appreciate more for all of the lovely support and kind words, thank you very much!

After seeing the huge support to the test and excitement for the Early Access from all of you, we decide to make some changes to the test period and the Early Access date. The test will end on Dec 15th(was Dec 31st), and the early access date is also changed from Jan 16th to Jan 3rd.

The early access version will have better optimized MOD support. A Mod editor will be included, please feel free to create your own content and mess around with the world and rules! Go crazy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/8dc275d59686e506724c3fd9412837c813b69cba.jpg[/img]

The early access release will support two types of MOD: The first one is the Campaign type (such as the main game), and the other is plug-in type (such as hero packs). The Mods will support cross-platform in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35992768/187830ada5d40f8fa661efdd17e70d94de4dec2f.jpg[/img]

[b]These are the updates that will be in the Early Access release:[/b]

[list]
[*] Bug fixes and balance changes.
[*] Changes to the gameplay loop which would lower the amount of grind needed.
[*] Add more backgrounds stories, skills, and endings to the characters.
[*] Changes to the difficulty balance for a better multiple playthrough experience
[*] Improve character art, UI, and other art design features.
[*] Supporting Steam achievements.
[/list]


We really hope to make this RPG+sandbox game and the desert fantasy world better and more charming! We are very sorry that the English version couldn’t make it when early access starts, but we assure you that it will be here ASAP! Please don’t forget to wishlist on steam！

Thank you all again for the lovely support!
